rows.name: Amodo
rows.short: Helping insurers place the right products with the right users at the right time.
rows.description: Amodo (acquired by Cambridge Mobile Telematics in 2023) is a customer engagement and powerful analytics technology combined in one. Amodo enables insurance companies, digital brokers and adjacent industries to market new products and services and engage users through smartphones. As value for customers rise, insurance businesses thrive.

rows.name: Abhi
rows.short: Pakistan's first financial wellness platform focused on democratizing credit for both individuals and businesses.
rows.description: Founded in 2021, Abhi is building practical financial infrastructure for emerging markets. As a next-generation neobank, it provides Earned Wage Access and flexible SME financing that give workers and businesses quicker, more reliable access to liquidity. The model solves everyday cash-flow challenges and makes essential financial services easier to reach. Abhi also became the first MENAP-based startup to receive the World Economic Forum’s Technology Pioneer Award.

rows.name: Abwab.ai
rows.short: AI-driven fintech platform that automates SME lending and credit decisions for banks and lenders across the Middle East and Africa.
rows.description: Founded in Saudi Arabia, Abwab.ai is a fintech-powered AI platform that transforms SME lending through automated underwriting and credit decisioning. It enables banks and lenders across the MENA region to make near-instant, data-driven credit assessments, replacing slow manual underwriting processes. By automating loan origination, lead qualification and credit analysis, Abwab.ai reduces risk, cuts costs and accelerates the flow of capital to small and medium enterprises. The company’s mission is to bridge the vast financing gap facing SMEs – unlocking growth and inclusion through smarter, faster, and technology-driven lending.

rows.name: Actiondesk
rows.short: Cloud spreadsheet connected to live data sources for analysis of real-time information.
rows.description: Actiondesk (acquired by Data Dog in 2023) is a cloud-based spreadsheet application that integrates with live data sources, enabling users to access and join data from across the cloud stack. By automatically connecting data directly from user databases and other services, the need for CSV export operations are eliminated. Users can run common spreadsheet functions, including lookups or pivot tables, using the same methods available in other spreadsheet applications.

rows.name: Adverity
rows.short: Intelligent data platform transforming marketing data into actionable, performance-driving insights.
rows.description: Adverity is an online marketing data analytics and reporting platform. Advertisers and marketing agencies use the platform to analyse real-time data from multiple popular marketing tools alongside offline data – such as Excel spreadsheets – to deliver insights into their marketing activities. Adverity efficiently compiles different data sources to help marketers take control of their marketing campaigns. Their products are web-based marketing intelligence and advanced analytics platforms that fully integrate input from several marketing tools into one application. This creates a united data stack for more efficient reporting, better decision making and improved marketing performance.

rows.name: aerska
rows.short: Pioneering RNA medicines to treat, delay, and prevent diseases of the brain.
rows.description: Dublin-based Aerska, with research operations in London, is leveraging advances in ‘brain shuttles’ to enable targeted delivery of next-generation RNAi therapeutics to the CNS. By silencing the genes that cause harm, Aerska aims to preserve the minds, protect the memories, and enable our loved ones to live longer, healthier lives.

rows.name: Afilio
rows.short: Legal and financial protection for individuals and businesses.
rows.description: Afilio provides families with a centralized location to create and consolidate personal estate management, legal, financial, and retirement planning.

rows.name: Agon
rows.short: Physical AI infrastructure for European defence.
rows.description: Agon builds physical AI infrastructure for European defence. Its platform is a synthetic combat arena where drones, robots and other autonomous systems are trained, tested and hardened against intelligent adversaries that adapt with them, across land, sea, air, space and cyber. As defence systems increasingly perceive, decide and act on their own, manufacturers need to iterate on them continuously rather than validate them once. Agon was founded in London in 2026 by Tristam Constant, former Europe director at Anduril and most recently head of European defence at Applied Intuition, and Junaid Hussain, co-founder of Cambridge Aerospace.

rows.name: Agro.Club
rows.short: Two-sided agricultural marketplace with embedded financial services.
rows.description: Agro.Club is digitizing the global agricultural value chain by connecting input suppliers, grain buyers, and farmers through a comprehensive digital ecosystem, aiming for greater transparency and efficiency in supply management. The platform offers essential digital services like e-commerce, grain procurement, and business intelligence. It also provides embedded financial solutions, including factoring and credit, directly within transactions, helping stabilize cash flow, expand capital access for agricultural partners, and simplifies complex supply chain interactions.

rows.name: Alinia AI
rows.short: Enabling the safe and controlled deployment of Generative AI, guided by companies´ policies and business preferences.
rows.description: With Alinia AI, enterprises can evaluate, control and optimize Generative AI applications. We empower subject-matter experts to guide Large Language Models' output based on companies' policies and preferences. We bring the safety, transparency, and evidence that both Executive and ML teams need to confidently deploy Gen AI applications.

rows.name: Ambio
rows.short: Trading infrastructure for high-quality recycled plastics.
rows.description: Ambio is building an AI-powered trading platform that makes recycled plastics easier to buy and sell at scale. It connects industrial manufacturers with verified recyclers, matching material requirements with thousands of available options while managing quality assurance, documentation, pricing, logistics and financing. By removing friction from a fragmented supply chain, Ambio helps make sustainable materials the most accessible and commercially attractive choice.

rows.name: Anda
rows.short: African mobility platform empowering drivers to own their vehicles.
rows.description: Founded in Angola, Anda is an African mobility and fintech platform that empowers drivers to own their vehicles through an accessible drive-to-own model. It provides training, insurance, maintenance support, and safe operating hubs, helping transform informal transport work into stable, dignified livelihoods. With its growing electric vehicle fleet, Anda is also driving cleaner, more affordable, and more organized urban mobility. The company is reshaping the sector by combining financial inclusion, human-capital development, and sustainable innovation.

rows.name: apiday
rows.short: Building the operating system of ESG data for forward-thinking companies.
rows.description: apiday’s purpose is to enable every company to be sustainability minded by helping them manage their ESG data as systematically and accurately as their financial data. With the apiday SaaS tool, companies gain control of their sustainability agenda, answer ESG data requests in moments, reduce reputational risks and unlock new opportunities.

rows.name: ARX Robotics
rows.short: Developing autonomous ground systems for next-generation European defense.
rows.description: ARX Robotics is a Munich-based defense tech company building autonomous unmanned ground systems (UGVs) designed to strengthen Europe’s defense capabilities through software-defined technologies. Its systems are already in use by several European armed forces. The company develops scalable hardware platforms and AI-powered software that modernize and network military vehicles and systems. ARX follows a fully European approach – from its proprietary Mithra OS to its supply chain – to ensure strategic independence in critical defense infrastructure.

rows.name: Asap.work
rows.short: Connecting construction companies with qualified temporary workers.
rows.description: Asap.work is revolutionizing the future of work in the construction industry by connecting construction companies with qualified temporary workers through a digital-first offer with personalized support. At the same time, skilled workers on the platform are also able to quickly find new employment opportunities and better-paying jobs.

rows.name: Astral Systems
rows.short: Pioneering transformative fusion technology to address real global health and energy challenges today.
rows.description: Astral Systems' mission is to provide innovative, cutting-edge fusion technology that enhances access to critical medical isotopes, accelerates fusion research, and lays the groundwork for sustainable energy systems. Led by Talmon Firestone, CEO, and Dr. Tom Wallace-Smith, CTO; Astral Systems is currently focused on solving the growing crisis surrounding the international medical isotope shortage, which is severely impacting cancer diagnosis and treatments. Astral’s compact reactors' unparalleled performance means they are poised to produce enough neutrons to offer an evergreen supply of isotopes, curtailing global manufacturing shortages.

rows.name: Atmosplay
rows.short: 3D playable ads for mobile games.
rows.description: Atmosplay (acquired in 2017) builds high-quality 3D playable ads for high-grossing mobile games. They let advertisers showcase their mobile games with fully animated interactive playable ads. Furthermore, their ads are delivered 10x faster than the current market leader’s.

rows.name: Autone
rows.short: An end-to-end operational decision platform for the luxury and broader consumer goods industry.
rows.description: Autone is an end-to-end operational decision platform for the luxury and broader consumer goods industry. With their user-friendly platform, they provide customers with decision recommendations of their inventory, demand, supply planning, pricing elasticity, and analytics operations in a slick and collaborative manner.

rows.name: avatao
rows.short: Helping developers deliver high-quality products by immersing them in real-life scenarios of security best practices.
rows.description: Avatao is a hands-on secure coding learning platform used by developers, security champions, pentesters, security analysts, and DevOps teams around the world to improve their IT security knowledge, and to speed up secure product development. The Avatao platform offers more than 600 real-life tutorials and challenges in the most popular programming languages, covering the most crucial security topics, from secure DevOps via API security to cryptography. Whether you need to teach your developers the fundamentals in a security awareness training, provide them a continuous training based on career tracks or build a security champions program, Avatao is the right tool for you.

rows.name: Bikemap
rows.short: Create, upload, and share your favorite cycle routes.
rows.description: Bikemap is a platform where bike enthusiasts around the world create, upload and share their favorite cycle routes. The Bikemap app lets users record routes on the go, add their own photos or notes and share it all on social media. Bikemap has evolved to become the largest bike route collection in the world– with active users in more than 80 countries sharing their cycling experiences from all around the world. More than 1,500 new routes are created by Bikemap users on a every day; enriched with information such as route length and interactive elevation profile for every cycling route. To date, users have access to more than 3 million different routes.

rows.name: Billie
rows.short: Offering merchants risk-free payment deferral options and flexible trade credit to their business customers.
rows.description: Billie's mission is to simplify the purchasing experience for businesses by providing flexible payment terms, such as "Pay Later" or "Pay in 3 installments," directly at the point-of-sale for merchants. The platform uses big data analytics and fully digitalized processes to offer merchants real-time payment approval and 100% default and fraud risk protection, ensuring they are paid upfront while their buyers can defer payment. Billie is integrated with major payment providers like Stripe and Adyen and aims to unlock cross-border trade and provide short-term liquidity solutions for SMEs across Europe.

rows.name: Bindbridge
rows.short: AI-based molecular discovery for agriculture.
rows.description: Bindbridge, the Cambridge-based Ag-biotech company, develops next-generation crop protection that shores up crop resilience and boosts food and agricultural outputs. Bindbridge’s revolutionary AI discovery tool enables the rational design of new agricultural compounds for targeted protein degradation, which are the building blocks of safer, more effective herbicides and next-gen crop protection agents.

rows.name: Bitfount
rows.short: A platform for federated AI and data collaboration.
rows.description: Bitfount enables modellers to gather insights and train models from other people’s data. Because of the federated nature of the platform, Bitfount enables data providers to share the benefits of their data without ever having to give up control or privacy.

rows.name: Bitmovin
rows.short: Providing the video streaming infrastructure used by global media companies.
rows.description: Bitmovin provides transcoding and media streaming solutions for developers and businesses. The company has developed the market's fastest API driven cloud-based video encoding service and an HTML5 Player that allows adaptive content to be played on any device, in any browser without buffering. Their API based products help developers around the world solve video problems with cloud-native software that runs anywhere. Since its founding in 2013, this Y Combinator alumni startup has created a portfolio of solutions for video streaming services that are used by companies like Periscope, RedBull Media House, The New York Times, and more for their adaptive video streaming and embedded video needs.

rows.name: Bitpanda
rows.short: Europe’s leading platform for investing in crypto, stocks, ETFs and precious metals.
rows.description: Bitpanda is fully regulated and licensed investment platform, enabling both retail and institutional users to trade a wide variety of assets, including cryptocurrencies, fractionalized stocks, Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs), and precious metals. Bitpanda Technology Solutions (BTS) offers a modular, white-label API infrastructure, allowing established banks and other FinTechs to rapidly integrate compliant digital asset trading and custody services into their own customer applications.

rows.name: Blindmate
rows.short: Lets your friends swipe for you, turning lonely swiping into a shared social experience.
rows.description: Dating apps promise connection but deliver isolation. Swiping alone through endless profiles only makes you lonelier. Blindmate lets your friends swipe for you, bringing the feeling of “we met through friends” online. The result is more than just a cure for loneliness; it creates a truly social dating environment with built-in virality.

rows.name: bliq
rows.short: Bringing driverless mobility to European cities.
rows.description: Berlin-based Bliq is building driverless cars for private and business use, starting in Europe. The company upgrades existing vehicles with a cost-efficient autonomous driving stack and operates them through a remote-supervised model that combines AI driving with human oversight. Bliq’s mission is to make fully driverless mobility available beyond robotaxis and bring autonomous vehicles into everyday life.

rows.name: BLNG
rows.short: End-to-end generative AI solution for jewelry design, customization, and digital merchandising.
rows.description: BLNG empowers designers to create high-quality jewelry concepts in seconds, enables brands and retailers to offer immersive customization experiences, and provides digital merchandising solutions with photorealistic visual effects. By integrating generative AI into every stage of the jewelry creation process, BLNG accelerates design workflows, enhances personalization, and transforms how jewelry is showcased and sold online.

rows.name: blocks
rows.short: AI-powered infrastructure layer for optimizing and controlling cloud spend.
rows.description: Blocks is a Berlin-based platform that helps startups and scaling companies reduce cloud costs through continuous optimization and aggregated purchasing power. By combining agentic DevOps automation with access to enterprise-level pricing, Blocks turns cloud spend from an opaque cost center into a controllable system. Designed to operate in the background without added complexity, it enables companies to improve efficiency and margins without building internal FinOps capabilities.

rows.name: Blocktorch
rows.short: End-to-end observability platform for logs, metrics, and traces for decentralized applications.
rows.description: Blocktorch (acquired by third web in 2024) is the observability platform for the decentralized stack, covering all observability pillars to empower web3 developers to scale every decentralized component globally and serve billions of users reliably. We help builders to understand the behaviour of a decentralised application holistically, act quickly and become data driven. By enabling best in class observability practices, blocktorch is on the mission to make web3 mass-market ready.

rows.name: BlubBlub
rows.short: Video modeling and gamified activities to help children improve their speech and language skills.
rows.description: Speech therapists still assign homework on sheets of paper, because the industry has not yet been digitized. BlubBlub decided to change this by introducing its video app, which triggers sounds and words recorded by children and for children, helping them to practice in their specific language to address their specific speech problem. BlubBlub connects children, therapists and parents on one platform to ensure everyone plays a role in each child's progress.

rows.name: Boltzbit
rows.short: Cost-effective and code-free foundation AI to empower businesses and developer communities.
rows.description: Foundation models are turbo-charging the future of AI , and it is happening right now. Built by top AI researchers, Boltzbit creates the first Foundation AI platform that allows its users to build multi-tasking continuous-learning AI from data without a single line of code. The solutions of Boltzbit AI have a wide range of use cases in financial services and digital marketing. The Boltzbit Foundation AI platform brings the open-source community, AI researchers, and AI solution builders together to push AI into the next level.

rows.name: Breathe Battery Technologies
rows.short: Building physics-based battery management software to support the electrification of our planet’s transport systems.
rows.description: Breathe Battery Technologies is a London-based startup and 2019 spin-out from Imperial College London founded by Dr. Yan Zhao, Dr. Ian Campbell and Professor Greg Offer. The company was founded in pursuit of universally clean air and a sustainable Earth. Today, Breathe is actively developing the technologies to improve battery safety, performance and cost to support the electrification of our planet’s transport systems. We create battery management software that provides deep insights into battery health. These insights are then used to improve the battery and to provide great software products to the automotive and consumer electronics markets.

rows.name: byrd
rows.short: B2B marketplace for full-service ecommerce fulfillment.
rows.description: Byrd is a managed B2B marketplace for eCommerce fulfillment. Their all-in-one logistics platform equips users with a comprehensive dashboard and connects to online shop systems such as Shopify and Woocommerce to make drop-shipping, eCommerce fulfillment or crowdfunding campaign management seamless. Byrd integrates with all major logistics partners in the German-speaking market and automatically finds the best provider for each shipment. The company also runs storage facilities in Europe, takes care of individual packaging, and manages pick-ups as well as returns.

rows.name: Candis
rows.short: Helping SMEs automate bookkeeping and financial workflows using AI.
rows.description: Candis makes workflows intelligent using an artificial intelligence tool that helps companies automate repetitive bookkeeping processes such as categorizing different invoices. The software can collect and handle invoices automatically and make sure everybody is paid on time, saving 80% of manual work. CANDIS also offers a special service for tax accountants facilitating the collaboration with clients and automating certain processes.

rows.name: Celus
rows.short: Empowering development teams to easily build embedded systems.
rows.description: The AI-powered CELUS Engineering Platform generates schematics, PCB-Layouts and BOM at the touch of a button. By automating all the manual steps in the engineering process, reducing development times by up to 90%.

rows.name: Charles.co
rows.short: A digital clinic specializing in men’s health.
rows.description: Charles is a digital clinic that addresses chronic health issues in men, such as sexual health, hair loss, or insomnia. Based in France, the startup offers all its services via an integrated digital platform developed in close collaboration with prominent medical experts on men’s health.

rows.name: Cherrypick
rows.short: Do your weekly grocery shop in a fraction of the time.
rows.description: The Cherrypick app turns the chore of grocery shopping into a delightful tech-driven experience by allowing users to complete their weekly shop in a few clicks. Users can easily set health goals, dietary requirements, choose recipes and plan meals for the week - Cherrypick then automatically fills up your shopping basket with the necessary ingredients and delivers them to your door.

rows.name: ClauseMatch
rows.short: Real-time document editing and collaboration for highly regulated industries.
rows.description: Evolve with compliance. The award-winning ClauseMatch policy management, regulatory change management and compliance SaaS platform automates time-sucking tasks, organizes your data and makes collaboration and knowledge-sharing a breeze.

rows.name: CoachHub
rows.short: Turnkey solution to transform your managers into highly effective, inspiring leaders.
rows.description: CoachHub is a Berlin-based global digital coaching platform built to provide personalized, measurable, and scalable talent development solutions for the entire enterprise workforce. The platform connects employees at all career levels with a worldwide network of over 3,500 certified business coaches across 90 countries and 80 languages via its proprietary mobile and web application. Blending human expertise and AI innovation, CoachHub uses an intelligent AI matching system to pair coachees with the most suitable certified coach. This dual approach, combining world-class human coaching with AI-driven personalization and the recently launched AI coach companion, AIMY™, democratizes access to professional development and drives measurable business outcomes across its 1,000+ enterprise clients.

rows.name: Cobee
rows.short: Take control of your salary.
rows.description: Cobee ( acquired by Pluxee in 2024 ) is an employee benefits company that is using new technologies to disrupt the big benefit market that has been traditionally dominated by big incumbent players. All our efforts are focused on making employees feel happy about their benefits, trying to unify the value proposition in an understandable and easy to use formula.

rows.name: Colorful
rows.short: Allowing brands to easily create photo-realistic visual content.
rows.description: Content creation is time-consuming and costly, while at the same time more content is needed than ever before. Colorful (acquired in 2023) solves this issue with the power of 3D. Insert the digital twin of your physical product into hundreds of pre-built scenes. Adjust the composition and get HQ results in no time thanks to cloud rendering. Export unlimited high-quality images and videos for all touchpoints: Website, social media, in-store, print, or TV.

rows.name: Complori
rows.short: An online learning platform teaching children 21st-century skills.
rows.description: Complori (acquired in 2025) is an educational tech company dedicated to teaching digital programming to kids aged 7 to 16. It utilizes an adaptive learning platform to offer paid, cohort-based coding classes, supplemented by a mobile app with free, gamified, self-paced content. Since launching in 2020, Complori has taught over 17,000 children how to code, including 800+ from low-income households via B2B partnerships. The startup has earned recognition in the digital education industry, winning awards such as the Innovationspreis Berlin.

rows.name: Complyance
rows.short: Enterprise risk and compliance, automated with intelligent agents.
rows.description: Complyance centralizes risk and compliance data across the enterprise, replacing fragmented tools and manual processes with automated, end-to-end GRC workflows. The platform provides a single source of truth for controls, risks, evidence, and policies, improving transparency and coordination across teams. Intelligent, domain-specific agents support compliance teams by continuously reviewing evidence, assessing vendors, tracking risks, and identifying gaps before they escalate. This enables organizations to reduce manual effort, respond faster to audits, and maintain a real-time view of their compliance and risk posture at scale.

rows.name: consola.finance
rows.short: The first end-to-end finance and accounting collaboration platform for web3 firms.
rows.description: consola.finance (acquired by Request Finance in 2024) is on a mission to bring clarity and control to companies’ crypto finances with the first human-readable block(chain) explorer with dedicated finance, accounting, bookkeeping and reporting tooling. consola.finance automates crypto finance processes, saves valuable time, reduces human errors and gives companies the opportunity to make better decisions.

rows.name: ContextSDK
rows.short: Enhancing mobile app engagement and revenue by leveraging real-world user context with Machine Learning.
rows.description: ContextSDK collects more than 200 signals from the modern smartphone to assess a user’s real-world context instantly - whether they're commuting, walking, or relaxing - and use this for intent detection. This allows for the delivery of precisely timed, context-aware notifications and content that enhance user satisfaction and drive conversions. Its on-device processing ensures privacy by avoiding cloud transfers, which preserves user trust. ContextSDK’s vision is to establish real-world context data as the new gold standard in mobile app engagement, providing product owners and CMOs with a powerful tool to continuously optimize user experiences.

rows.name: Conundrum
rows.short: Industrial automation powered by AI.
rows.description: Conundrum helps industrial companies to leapfrog into Industry 4.0 by leveraging value hidden in data and introducing AI-driven technologies. The UK-based technology company's software helps industrial companies address the following: predictive maintenance, quality control and industrial processes optimization. Its software is based on its proprietary machine learning technologies for industrial time series analysis.

rows.name: Crate.io
rows.short: Distributed SQL database for real-time industrial data and IoT applications.
rows.description: The next wave of big data will be generated by IoT (Internet of Things) devices such as sensors, wearables, and vehicles, generating millions of data points per second. Crate.io was founded to help companies process this data and establish a standard for database developers with its decentralized SQL database for managing machine data and analyzing it in real time. Making traditional central databases obsolete and allowing companies to store their data on different application services, providing simplicity and scalability.

rows.name: Credi2
rows.short: BNPL for banks, financial service providers, trading companies, and their end customers.
rows.description: Credi2 develops and operates “Buy now, pay later” payment solutions (BNPL) for banks, financial service providers, trading companies and their end customers. An important success factor is the [credi2] technology platform, which can handle all processes fully automatically. With this platform individual and user-friendly financing solutions are implemented - together with customers such as Apple, Volkswagen Bank and Raiffeisen Bank International. The best known are cashpresso and FINANCE A BIKE.

rows.name: Curve
rows.short: One card. One app. Zero hassle.
rows.description: Curve ( acquired by Lloyds Banking Group in 2025 ) helps people simplify their finances by connecting different debit and credit cards as well as accounts to one single card and smart app. The app serves as a dashboard where people can manage their different accounts as well as keep track of their spending habits. It’s the only card customers need to carry (and the only pin they need to remember!) Curve also helps address the privacy and security aspect of payments. The app automatically alerts users every time the card is used and gives people the ability to instantly lock the card from the app in case of fraudulent payments or loss as well as unlock it again later.

rows.name: Cyberwrite
rows.short: Helping insurance companies manage their cyber-insurance underwriting business.
rows.description: Founded by cyber experts and actuaries – Cyberwrite delivers a cyber insurance underwriting solution for the growing SMB cyber insurance market. Cyberwrites helps insurers who lack the analytics technology and actuarial data needed for SMB and SME cyber underwriting. These insurers otherwise assume high risk services estimated to reach over $1T annually. Cyberwrite has offices in San Francisco and in Tel Aviv, and graduated from 500Startups, Plug and Play, and Citi Accelerator. The company is working with several large customers and is backed by SpeedInvest and prominent insurance and cyber security angel investors.

rows.name: cylib
rows.short: Sustainable technology for Li-ion battery recycling, for a true circular economy.
rows.description: cylib aims to secure global raw material demands by recycling Li-ion batteries. This is realized by a proprietary, resource-efficient and environmentally friendly end-to-end process. The holistic cylib-process gives commodities another life by treating used batteries and transforming them into marketable raw materials. With cylib’s process, it is possible to recover all battery components. This also includes Lithium and Graphite among other materials that are currently not recovered from batteries in the EU. The recycling process was developed over many years of research at RWTH Aachen University and contains all the relevant process steps, like mechanical, thermal and chemical treatments to reach high yields.

rows.name: Deblock
rows.short: Deblock is Europe’s first on-chain current account, combining everyday banking with a self-custody crypto wallet.
rows.description: Founded by former Revolut and Ledger executives, Deblock is Europe’s first fully on-chain banking solution, combining a regulated euro current account with a personal, self-custody crypto wallet. Regulated by the Banque de France as an Electronic Money Institution and licensed under MiCA by the AMF, Deblock meets the highest European financial standards. By merging traditional banking simplicity with Web3 infrastructure, Deblock lets users seamlessly manage payments, savings, and investments while maintaining full ownership of their funds. This unified platform enables access to everyday finance and decentralised services without compromising security or control.

rows.name: Deep Render
rows.short: Using deep learning and quantum techniques to develop next-generation image and video codecs.
rows.description: Deep Render (acquired by InterDigital in 2025) is an AI company developing the next generation of image and video compression algorithms. Their proprietary and patented image-compression technology is at the forefront of machine learning research, providing a 10x improvement over the current industry standards. Deep Render´s vision is to combine the fields of Artificial Intelligence, Statistics and Information theory to unlock the fundamental limits of image and video compression. Their Biological compression approximates the neurological processes of the human eye through a non-linear, context-aware, learning-based approach, thereby creating a novel class of highly efficient compression algorithms. Moreover, while the traditional compression methods (HEIC; HEIF; AV1; VVC) have hit peak-innovation with significantly declining performance gains per iteration, Biological Compression technology is only starting.

rows.name: Dialpad
rows.short: The AI-powered platform for modern business communications.
rows.description: Speedinvest became a shareholder in Dialpad following its acquisition of Sufboard in 2024. Dialpad is an AI-native cloud communications platform that unifies calls, messaging, video, and contact center operations in one system. With built-in real-time transcription, summaries, and analytics, it helps teams improve productivity and customer engagement at scale. Through its acquisition of Surfboard, Dialpad expanded its workforce management capabilities, helping customer support teams forecast demand, schedule staff, and optimize contact center operations more effectively.

rows.name: Diligent
rows.short: The autonomous AI platform for financial crime compliance.
rows.description: Diligent AI builds AI agents for KYC and AML teams, automating reasoning-heavy workflows such as sanctions screening, adverse media analysis, and merchant due diligence. By replacing static compliance processes with autonomous AI analysts that read, reason, and investigate, the platform reduces operational costs while improving risk detection and decision quality across financial institutions.

rows.name: Djust
rows.short: Modular B2B commerce platform automating sales operations
rows.description: DJUST is a modular B2B commerce platform that enables companies to streamline their sales operations and increase productivity across the organization. With advanced payment capabilities and an Agentic Commerce approach, DJUST is redefining how businesses design, manage, and automate their commercial interactions. The platform empowers leading distributors, retailers, and manufacturers to break down system silos, digitise manual processes, and unlock new growth opportunities. More than a flexible order management system, DJUST is a foundational layer that helps future-proof businesses through scalability and continuous innovation. Backed by a global partner network, DJUST combines technological expertise with a human touch, supported by a team of 50+ B2B digital commerce experts across Europe.

rows.name: Doccla
rows.short: Building the next-gen virtual ward company.
rows.description: Doccla is pioneering the virtual ward technology needed to ease pressure on hospitals and other healthcare providers, by reinventing remote patient monitoring (RPM) with innovative medical monitoring solutions to deliver safe, effective care from the home. This helps hospitals alleviate the pressure on resources, enabling the early discharge of patients while remaining under the care of clinicians. Industry-leading patient compliance, together with fewer readmissions and lower costs, have direct effects on healthcare providers and patients who can be taken care of in the comfort of their homes.

rows.name: Donnerstag.ai
rows.short: AI-driven platform that helps suppliers automate receivables and spot discrepancies in real time.
rows.description: Founded by fintech veterans Barbaros Özbugutu and Volkan Özkan, Donnerstag.ai is transforming how suppliers manage receivables through an AI-powered platform. It integrates delivery, billing, and banking data to detect discrepancies in real time and reconcile transactions automatically. This gives finance teams full visibility, reduces revenue leakage, and improves liquidity control. Built in Germany and designed for Europe’s supply chains, Donnerstag.ai brings automation to one of the most overlooked areas of financial operations.

rows.name: drag&bot
rows.short: Supporting production companies to cost-effectively automate with industrial robots.
rows.description: drag&bot (acquired by KEBA in 2022) is an intuitive, web-based software platform for easy setup, programming and operation of industrial robots. With its graphical interface no prior robotics skills are needed to step your company into the era of automation. Their solution can be deployed across all relevant, industrial robotic systems and offers a high degree of flexibility, making industrial robots economical even for small production batches.

rows.name: Dronamics
rows.short: Heavy-duty, long-range cargo drone capable of same-day deliveries across continents.
rows.description: Dronamics is reinventing the future of cargo shipping through drones. Specializing in middle-mile cargo logistics through unpiloted aircraft, Dronamics has developed the Black Swan, a proprietary, heavy-duty cargo drone designed to offer high-capacity, long-range air freight services. The Black Swan drone can carry up to 350 kg (770 lbs) across distances of up to 2,500 km (1,550 miles), which is significant for unpiloted air cargo. This capability allows Dronamics to undercut traditional air freight costs, making rapid delivery accessible to remote and underserved regions.

rows.name: Drop
rows.short: Helping brands maximize their social commerce potential.
rows.description: Borrowing from text marketing’s incredible reach, and email’s high acquisition powers, Drop allows brands to leverage Instagram direct messages at scale, for the first time, with impactful results like decreased cost-per-acquisition (CPA), increased return-on-ad-spend (ROAS), and ultimately, revenue. Drop has helped a spectrum of brands and retailers like Ana Luisa, Culture Kings, PANGAIA and Hot Topic in this new journey from follower to customer. From the next-gen, hypergrowth DTC brands to the well-established names, they’ve all experienced a decrease in acquisition costs and boost in growth. Drop’s momentum reveals the eCommerce industry’s shift towards social, headless (not on traditional site) shopping experiences.

rows.name: Due
rows.short: Reshaping international payments through blockchain and stablecoin innovations.
rows.description: Established in 2022, Due is a London-based fintech startup with a vision to reshape international payments through blockchain and stablecoin innovations. The company provides borderless multi-currency accounts, global transfers / remittances and merchant acquiring for individuals and businesses. Due built its platform on top of public blockchains, leveraging stablecoin liquidity markets across Europe, US, LatAm and Africa to enable accessible, fast, and cheap international money movements for clients around the world. Due’s platform is non-custodial, meaning the clients always have full control of, and direct access to, their assets on public blockchains without the involvement of intermediaries.

rows.name: Ellipsus
rows.short: Making it easy for anyone to write together.
rows.description: Ellipsus is helping a new generation of writers create culture together. The writing tool—which combines the best of modern text editors with the granular version control championed by Git—aims to thread collaboration through every stage of writing, editing, and publishing. Founded in late 2022, Ellipsus is currently in private beta testing.

rows.name: Emmi AI
rows.short: Revolutionizing industrial engineering with next-generation AI simulation technology.
rows.description: Emmi AI (acquired by Mistral in 2026) tackles previously unsolvable industrial engineering challenges by applying cutting-edge AI to physics-based simulations. The Austrian-based company dramatically accelerates complex simulations, reducing run times from days or weeks to seconds, enabling industries like aerospace and automotive to overcome critical bottlenecks and unlock unprecedented efficiency. Emmi AI's unique strength lies in its fusion of deep learning expertise and deep industrial understanding, validated by significant early customer contracts. With the vision to deliver the 'GPT moment' in physics AI, they are building intelligent, data-driven digital twins that learn and optimize in real time, paving the way for a new era of AI-enabled engineering.

rows.name: EstateGuru
rows.short: Cross-border platform for short-term property loans.
rows.description: Through a technology-enabled platform, EstateGuru connects borrowers and lenders and enables fast, transparent and cost-effective funding solutions.

rows.name: Eunice
rows.short: Bridging data and action to empower the sustainable development of Web3 and Crypto.
rows.description: Eunice is an AI fintech company solving B2B challenges in digital assets. Their first product is digital asset due diligence and monitoring to help financial institutions, regulators, and businesses navigate the complexities of the digital asset space. Powered by a proprietary knowledge base, Eunice’s platform enables token classification, risk analysis, and asset disclosure requirements. With a mission to bring transparency to the digital asset industry, Eunice builds products that drive regulatory clarity and operational efficiency, intending to accelerate the mainstream adoption of digital assets.

rows.name: Exactly.ai
rows.short: Creative design tool for professional artists to utilize AI to scale and market their work.
rows.description: Unlike existing Gen AI platforms that aim to bypass human creativity with AI, exactly is purpose-built to allow artists to create and replicate more designs, more quickly, in their own unique style – and maintain full ownership and IP rights over everything they create. exactly enables artists to build and train their own Gen AI models based on their individual artistic practice and original designs, producing brilliant work at speed without compromise or constraint. Using exactly, artists can enhance their productivity and accomplish more, faster, and hone their craft thanks to the ability to make rapid, limitless iterations on any design. In just a short time since launch, exactly has nurtured a community of more than 30,000 users purely through word-of-mouth and they have ambitious plans to expand the offering further during 2024 and beyond.

rows.name: EXA Finance
rows.short: The most advanced marketplace for NFTs and fungible tokens on Algorand.
rows.description: Incubated by Draper University and backed by prominent VCs, EXA Finance is the most advanced marketplace for NFTs and fungible tokens on Algorand. The platform offers a multitude of features such as assets bundle, NFT to NFT swap, auctions, offers, royalties, and peer-to-peer chat just to name a few. Users can now sell NFTs for any fungible token but also swap an NFT for multiple NFTs, opening a new range of possibilities.

rows.name: Factris
rows.short: Working capital financing to businesses by using their outstanding invoices as collateral.
rows.description: Factris provides asset based financing, mostly using outstanding invoices as collateral to improve client cash flow and working capital. The company works directly with businesses or via financial intermediaries or entrepreneurial brokers to deliver its services in a quick, friendly manner at the lowest cost.

rows.name: Fairlyne
rows.short: Resale-as-a-Service platform for the travel industry.
rows.description: Fairlyne is building the world’s 1 st resale-as-a-service platform for the travel industry, allowing travel brands to generate incremental revenue and deliver a seamless Resale experience to their customers.

rows.name: FairMoney
rows.short: Providing digital banking and instant loans to customers across Nigeria and India.
rows.description: FairMoney leverages big data to give access to credit to 2 billion people in emerging markets across the world. Consumers and businesses in these markets often suffer from missing access to credit. FairMoney uses advanced machine learning applied to smartphone data to build credit scores and distribute credit through any mobile application.

rows.name: Fairplay
rows.short: Supporting entrepreneurs’ growth in Latin America with a flexible, fast and friendly financial product.
rows.description: Fairplay is a revenue-based financing enabler for the new digital economy in Latin America with the mission to empower entrepreneurs’ growth with a fast, flexible and friendly product by investing in their working capital cycles directly through their three main needs: performance marketing campaigns, logistics costs and inventories. For fast-growing e-commerce businesses, Fairplay offers growth capital funding in exchange for a steady revenue share of their earnings until capital is paid back plus a flat fee.

rows.name: Fasset
rows.short: AI-powered stablecoin neobanking for the world's underserved markets
rows.description: Fasset is a Dubai-based fintech giving individuals and businesses in emerging markets access to modern banking, stablecoins, and tokenised investments. Its Own Network connects banks, telcos, and payment providers across 125 countries, using AI to power efficient cross-border settlement.

rows.name: Fernride
rows.short: Dual-use, human-assisted autonomous trucking for industrial logistics and European defense supply chains.
rows.description: Fernride (acquired by Quantum Systems in 2025) is a Munich-based ground autonomy platform that specializes in human-supervised autonomous trucking for critical infrastructure and defense logistics. The company retrofits existing vehicles, primarily terminal tractors and trucks, with AI, sensors, and software to automate repetitive cargo movements within industrial yards, container terminals, and manufacturing sites. Fernride also deploys its certified technology into European defense logistics, leveraging the same platform to enhance mission resilience and reduce human risk in military supply chains.

rows.name: Fertifa
rows.short: Enabling companies, large and small, to put DEI and employee well-being into practice.
rows.description: Having offered fertility clinical advice longer than anyone else in Europe, Fertifa now also provides clinical care advice and wellbeing support for all of women’s health including menopause; men’s reproductive health; and fertility and family-forming. Fertifa is the most inclusive and comprehensive benefits provider for reproductive, hormonal and sexual health, making it accessible for any individual, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age or relationship status.

rows.name: Fiat Republic
rows.short: A purpose-built, fiat-as-a-service platform to solve fiat access challenges for crypto platforms.
rows.description: Fiat Republic is on a mission to democratize fiat access for the Web3 economy. Fiat access is a systemic problem for crypto platforms and therefore requires a systemic solution. With our developer-first API, you can easily access everything you need to deliver better fiat experiences to your users and treasury teams. We’re unlocking and aggregating an ever increasing number of fiat rails with local and global tier-1 banks. Fiat Republic is able to give crypto platforms reliable access to best-in-class fiat products, all via a single API. We have developed a compliance-first approach that minimises friction in the on-ramp and off-ramp fiat-crypto flows. Our technology is augmented by the Fiat Republic Consortium. We’re building a coalition of crypto platforms to create a united voice, enabling us to continually add tier-1 global and local banking partners and have a seat at the table with regulators, to shape and influence the future rules that govern the space.

rows.name: Fifth Dimension
rows.short: Revolutionizing complex, repetitive, and document-heavy workflows with AI.
rows.description: Fifth Dimension AI is transforming the property industry with its AI product, Ellie, the ultimate real estate professional. By tackling tedious, manual tasks, Ellie liberates people to focus on high-value work. Developed by a team with deep expertise across Real Estate, Fintech, and AI, Ellie transcends the role of a typical digital assistant. Her nuanced understanding of the sector's intricacies, coupled with 98.4% accuracy in data extraction, has driven impressive 43% efficiency gains for early adopters. With operations established in the UK and expansion underway in the US market, Fifth Dimension AI is redefining AI-human collaboration in real estate and beyond.

rows.name: Finary
rows.short: Track all investments automatically and in real-time, regardless of the asset class.
rows.description: Finary is a wealth management platform that provides users with an all-in-one, real-time dashboard of their investments across all asset classes. Finary counts 10,000 banks and investment platforms in Europe and the US connected to its system and covers saving accounts, stocks, crypto, real estate, precious metals, and startup investments overviews. Features such as real-time performance analysis, calculation of hidden costs and automatic identification of new opportunities allow Finary to offer tailor-made asset management that, previously, was only reserved for the wealthy.

rows.name: FinCompare
rows.short: Helping SMEs find, compare, and close on the right financing solution.
rows.description: FinCompare (acquired by VAD Beteiligungen GmbH in 2021) is a comparison platform for financing options aimed at small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) seeking funding starting at 10,000 €. Via the online platform, businesses can access a wide range of financing options. Companies can independently compare offers from over 200 well-known banks, fintechs, and financial services providers and close on the financing. In addition to the usual corporate loans, FinCompare offers alternative financing solutions such as factoring, and leasing.

rows.name: Finres
rows.short: Providing AI and science-based solutions for banks to optimize agricultural investments in the face of climate change.
rows.description: finres is revolutionizing decision-making in rural economies. By analyzing past and current trends and extremes in climate using AI and science, the France-based team can accurately predict future climate trends in the wake of global warming and climate change. This information is shared with banks and international organizations, along with measures farmers can take to ensure that their crops, livestock, and livelihoods do not suffer. By breaking down the barriers between research and the private sector, Finres is building a bridge between finance and agricultural resilience. The company currently operates in 32 countries across 4 continents and has supported over 1.4 billion worth of investments, with an increase in productivity per hectare of up to 50%.

rows.name: Firsty
rows.short: Offering eSIM-based no-cost essential connectivity and high-speed connectivity from €1 per day.
rows.description: Free mobile data for the world. That's the mission of Firsty, a next-generation telecom provider reshaping how travelers, expats, and remote workers access mobile data across the globe. Firsty offers free eSIMs through their app for easy, one-click installation, saving time and hassle. Firsty Free gives you the essentials: WhatsApp, Email, Google Maps, and online calls. Users can also upgrade to Firsty Fast for higher speeds and access to all apps.

rows.name: Five Lives
rows.short: Building digital tools for the tracking and improvement of cognitive health.
rows.description: Five Lives builds engaging and accessible digital tools for the tracking and improvement of cognitive health. Their mobile app helps prevent and detect dementia years earlier and at a fraction of the cost of current methods, extending quality of life for millions of people through personalized lifestyle improvements. The Five Lives team is diverse and experienced with proven ability to build and scale world-leading mobile apps. The core team worked together previously at Peak (60M downloads, 5M monthly active users), is led by successful entrepreneurs and has close input from expert scientific advisors.

rows.name: Flank
rows.short: An AI colleague for expert teams.
rows.description: Flank is pioneering autonomous AI agents to transform enterprise legal, compliance, and security operations. The Berlin-based company addresses a core challenge for many organizations: the significant time and resources lost to high-volume, repetitive tasks, which prevents strategic focus. Flank believes critical functions like legal, compliance, and security should be powered by intelligent automation, enabling human experts to focus on complex, high-value work. To achieve this, Flank builds and deploys invisible AI agents directly embedded within existing enterprise systems. Its innovative approach revolutionizes how businesses manage these critical workflows, driving efficiency and ensuring compliance by automating what was once manual and time-consuming.

rows.name: Flaviar
rows.short: D2C spirits club providing education, discovery, and access to the world of fine spirits.
rows.description: Born out of frustration of how inaccessible fine spirits are today, Flaviar offers its members unparalleled access, be it in the form of information on spirits and personalized recommendations, or in the liquid form, through their Tasting Boxes, private labels, exclusive bottling, and live experiences.

rows.name: Fleksy
rows.short: 3rd party mobile keyboard with integrated social & productivity features.
rows.description: Fleksy integrates a multitude of productivity, eCommerce and entertainment services directly into the keyboard. Since most users spend a lot of time in messaging apps, switching from application to application and can now use their time more efficiently. Fleksy lets you attach documents, photos, to-dos, create events, and even more while messaging – all within your keyboard. Discover an intuitive gesture system coupled with auto-correction in 65+ languages. Holder of the world’s record for the fastest keyboard, Fleksy makes typing on a mobile smartphone a breeze!

rows.name: Flexkeeping
rows.short: Hotel operations software empowering hospitality professionals to work more efficiently.
rows.description: Flexkeeping (acquired by Mews in 2025) is a complete software solution for hotel housekeeping and operations helping hospitality professionals save time and work more efficiently. Processes that previously required manual work, multiple phone calls, and paper reports can now be managed from one simple application improving how hotel staff communicates, delegates tasks, and manages processes. The company’s software solution saves hotels hundreds of man-hours per month, drastically reduces inventory loss, and boosts productivity. World-class hotels all over Europe like Le Meridien, Holiday Inn, and Radisson Blu have adopted Flexkeeping as their operations software of choice.

rows.name: Flinn
rows.short: Enabling MedTech companies to automate quality & regulatory processes to launch and operate products 10x more efficiently.
rows.description: Flinn's vision is to make high-quality health products accessible for everyone. The first major milestone on this journey is to enable medical device manufacturers to automate quality and regulatory processes. The go-to-market product sets the focus on the automation of post-market surveillance processes. This means automating the collection, evaluation, and reporting of relevant data through smart workflows, integrations, and the support of AI.

rows.name: Flow48
rows.short: Offering revenue-based financing to online and offline businesses.
rows.description: By embedding in the customer’s payment gateway, Flow48 can offer businesses upfront lump-sum investment capital to invest in inventory or CAPEX and generate future revenues.

rows.name: Flowdesk
rows.short: Allowing web3 token issuers to manage their liquidity actively through Market-Making as a Service.
rows.description: In a context of exponential growth of token issuers in the web3 space, Flowdesk is building an infrastructure to help them tackle their financial needs with a more transparent and controlled approach. Flowdesk has built a scalable infrastructure that connects crypto-exchanges to innovative products, such as Market-Making as a Service (MMaaS). MMaaS is radically different than traditional liquidity provisions where issuers fully own their liquidity and can control the strategy according to their needs. To support their vision of scalable and regulated market-making in crypto , Flowdesk offers banking-grade compliance and stringent procedures to guarantee they always work in the best interests of issuers.

rows.name: ForTunes
rows.short: Mobile music data analytics app for self-published artists and small labels.
rows.description: ForTunes (acquired by Utopia Music in 2023) puts comprehensive Music Data Analytics at the fingertips of a new generation of music creators by collecting, fetching, and visualizing data and providing customers with insights that help them understand who is playlisting & uploading their music and how their audience is growing.

rows.name: forward earth
rows.short: Easy-to-use, AI-powered environmental management seamlessly integrated into existing compliance and supply chain software.
rows.description: Decarbonization has become a crucial regulatory requirement for businesses globally, yet the vast majority of companies still do not have clear visibility into their environmental impact, especially deeper down the supply chain. forward earth has built a product that empowers businesses worldwide to become sustainable and compliant with little effort and cost. By embedding our AI-automated environmental management software into our partners’ software, forward earth will support millions of businesses in every aspect of their reporting lifecycle as they undertake their decarbonization journey in the years to come.

rows.name: Friday Finance
rows.short: Business finance, simplified.
rows.description: Friday Finance (acquired by Pliant in 2023) is the next-generation financial operations platform for startups and SMEs that puts all bank accounts and financial data into one place and helps them streamline and automate mundane tasks. It provides real-time insights into a business's cash flows and offers finance professionals better workflows for bill payments, approvals and the month-end close.

rows.name: Fuse
rows.short: Bringing price transparency to US healthcare.
rows.description: With only one in six patients knowing their costs upfront, and providers losing up to 10% of revenue to insurer underpayments, healthcare financial inefficiency is widespread in the US, even though clinics spend over 20% of their budgets on billing and collections. Fuse uses AI to automate tedious tasks like checking portals and calling insurers, so patients get accurate cost estimates before treatment and clinics save time previously spent on manual estimates and bill explanations.

rows.name: Genie
rows.short: Providing low/no-code tools for building data science applications.
rows.description: Genie is an open source startup providing low/no-code tools for building data science applications. With Genie, data scientists and R&D engineers can quickly turn ML models and simulations into shareable web apps and data products that drive the business forward.

rows.name: GetVocal
rows.short: Building reliable AI phone agents that give businesses full control over conversations through performance-driven, continuously learning voice technology.
rows.description: GetVocal builds reliable AI phone agents that combine the flexibility of LLMs with the control businesses need. At the core is a proprietary Conversational Graph OS that structures conversations for goal-oriented, auditable, and high-performing automation. Unlike black-box systems, it lets users orchestrate the balance between deterministic and generative behavior. Each interaction feeds real-time data back into the system to continuously improve outcomes.

rows.name: Gigs
rows.short: Turning any brand into a next-generation mobile provider.
rows.description: Gigs, the operating system for mobile services, empowers tech companies to seamlessly embed connectivity into their offerings in weeks. By bundling phone plans and travel data with their core services, Gigs' customers can increase stickiness and unlock a new recurring revenue stream with digital mobile experiences that meaningfully create value for consumers. Gigs' end-to-end platform provides everything brands like Klarna, Nubank, and OnePay need to launch and operate their own multi-market mobile service: premium connectivity, a hosted checkout, billing, subscription management, analytics, and AI-powered customer service.

rows.name: GoStudent
rows.short: Personalized tutoring platform, built for scale.
rows.description: GoStudent is a leading European EdTech platform built to provide flexible, one-to-one tutoring services for school-aged students. The company operates entirely online, connecting K-12 learners with a verified global network of educators through its proprietary virtual classroom environment via video conferencing. Providing long-term academic support, GoStudent also utilizes AI-powered matching to pair students with the most compatible tutor based on their learning style and specific academic needs, promoting greater continuity and personalized success.

rows.name: GoTiger
rows.short: Delivering Asian groceries, today.
rows.description: GoTiger is building the gateway of choice for shopping for Asian groceries. The same-day delivery startup offers a high-quality assortment, geared toward the taste of Western consumers with an interest in Asian food and lifestyle. From tasty dumplings to spicy ramen, from sashimi-quality fish to juicy fruits - GoTiger offers a unique selection of groceries from countries like Japan, Korea, and China as well as everyday essentials - delivered on the same day within a 2-hour time slot.

rows.name: Grace
rows.short: Offering luxury brands tech-driven, embedded protection for their customers' high-value items.
rows.description: Grace empowers luxury brands to offer their clients seamless, complimentary protection against theft and loss — from watches and jewelry to high-end travel pieces. Designed for the modern luxury consumer, Grace transforms traditional insurance into a branded, elevated experience that enhances the emotional and service promise of luxury ownership. By integrating cutting-edge technology with deep luxury market expertise, Grace enables partner brands to deliver instant, personalized protection without friction, and at no additional cost to the client. We’ve created a first-of-its-kind embedded coverage model that replaces outdated, complex claim processes with a smooth, tech-enabled solution designed specifically for luxury. This breakthrough model redefines luxury ownership by creating new standards of luxury service, generating high-value post-sale engagement, and unlocking proprietary data and insights. Grace is currently used by leading luxury maisons and backed by a top-tier insurer. With a growing footprint across Europe and beyond, Grace is setting a new standard for peace of mind in luxury.

rows.name: Grandhood
rows.short: Occupational pension for small businesses.
rows.description: Grandhood (acquired by Velliv in 2020) is the first company worldwide to offer an occupational pension based on the needs of small businesses. It stands out with its simplicity and applicability apart from large-scale enterprises.

rows.name: Greyparrot
rows.short: AI-based waste recognition software to monitor, audit, and sort waste at scale.
rows.description: Greyparrot provides waste recognition software that identifies materials using AI-based computer vision to monitor, audit and sort waste at scale. Their goal is to empower waste managers with actionable insights to increase recycling rates. Greyparrot is committed to unlocking the financial value of waste, which will, in turn, keep our environment clean for generations to come.

rows.name: gronda
rows.short: Career platform for the hospitality and gastronomy sector.
rows.description: Gronda is an industry blog and community platform designed to facilitate recruitment, transparency and knowledge exchange in the hospitality and gastronomy industries. The platform helps industry professionals showcase their expertise as well as connecting and applying to open positions. For companies, this is a one-stop-shop platform to recruit talent, build their employer brand, and solve their industry’s persistent labor shortage.

rows.name: Gustav
rows.short: Helping SMEs recruit and manage contractors and contingent workers at scale.
rows.description: Gustav (acquired by Fuse Cooperative in 2023) is a technology company that helps mid-sized enterprises recruit and manage their contingent workforce. Their service gives the mid-market access to benefits usually only enjoyed by large corporations with more sophisticated contingent workforce programs. Their full concierge software helps companies manage the complete process from selecting staffing vendors, submitting requisitions, managing an external workforce, to paying contractors and temporary staff. Ever since the company’s foundation in 2016 Gustav has received major support from organizations and investors such as Y Combinator, Speedinvest, Lightspeed Ventures, Beenext, 10x Group and YouTube co-founder Jawed Karim.

rows.name: Gyre Energy
rows.short: Turning cooling infrastructure into an intelligent energy asset.
rows.description: Gyre Energy, an Oxford-founded energy tech company, is building the AI optimisation layer for industrial cooling. Its platform combines AI and thermal energy storage to reduce energy use, lower peak power costs and make cold chains, buildings and future data centre infrastructure more resilient.

rows.name: Haaven
rows.short: A homebuilding platform surrounding customers with the best architects, engineers, and builders.
rows.description: At Haaven, we turn home building into a stress-free experience. Our platform offers a clear, end-to-end process that eliminates surprises, whether it's where to start, how long it will take, or how much it will cost. By connecting you with a trusted network of architects, engineers, and builders, we ensure your dream home comes to life on time and within budget. We're with you from the first idea to construction and aftercare, making the process smooth and enjoyable. Europe needs more and better homes for people and the planet. Haaven meets this need by uniting construction companies across Europe onto a single platform. Our homes are built carbon neutral, using wood in prefabricated designs to reduce carbon emissions. We also preserve architectural diversity by allowing architects from all over Europe to add their designs to our platform, combining the benefits of prefab construction with unique designs.

rows.name: Harbor Lab
rows.short: A SaaS solution that automates port expense analysis using real-time tariffs.
rows.description: Disbursements are all the expenses an agent makes on behalf of the operator whilst the vessel is in port. Harbor Lab was born out of a real-time need to automate the processing of disbursements (port costs payments to port authorities and other port-related suppliers), while reducing manual intervention and heavy administration. Utilizing Harbor Lab's platform is adding value for shipowning and shipmanaging companies & charterers. It gains efficiency and cost-savings through transparency, connectivity, & customisation.

rows.name: Haz
rows.short: AI-enabled social commerce app connecting people through the things they own.
rows.description: Haz makes it easier for people to buy and sell their belongings, by using AI technology to remove the time consuming, frictious and manual processes traditionally associated with resale. Our proprietary receipt reading technology allows our users' belongings to be digitised automatically and in real time, significantly increasing the liquidity of everyday items such as clothing and electronics. Our mission is to create a new type of social connection which is entertaining, good for the planet and great for your wallet.

rows.name: Helu.io
rows.short: Streamlining budgeting, controlling, and reporting.
rows.description: Helu's core functionality focuses on automatically turning bookings-level data into financial reports and streamlining the processes of budgeting, controlling, and reporting into a seamless process. Helu can be used by any company that uses DATEV - directly or indirectly via the tax consultant.

rows.name: hexafarms
rows.short: AI-powered SaaS solution enabling commercial food producers to track and predict their production capacity in real time.
rows.description: Greenhouses and indoor farms are able to grow high-quality produce year-round and are becoming the backbone of global food production. However, they struggle to keep up with increasing prices on all levels- energy, labor, and operations. Using AI models trained to understand plant biology at a commercial scale, hexafarms provides actionable insights and forecasts production capacity weeks in advance. They help growers increase their bottom line profit margins by up to 30% by reducing crop loss and manual inspections. Based in Berlin, the company currently serves growers across the EU.

rows.name: hi.health
rows.short: Convenient and safe access to private health insurance billing.
rows.description: hi.health (acquired by Pliant in 2025) offers people with private health insurance convenient and safe access to health care billing via app or web. Users can easily submit their invoices digitally and hi.health takes care of the further processing, billing and customer service providing a seamless user experience. With the integrated “library” users receive a transparent overview of relevant digital health products and services, that are (partially) covered by their insurance.

rows.name: Holvi
rows.short: Digital banking for entrepreneurs, sole traders, and business owners.
rows.description: Holvi (acquired by BBVA) is a digital banking solution and payment institution for European entrepreneurs, sole traders and business owners. With Holvi, SME’s can sell products online, send invoices, and track cashflow in real time. The platform offers a current account with its own IBAN number designed to help customers manage all their finances on one platform. Holvi is the world’s first financial hub operating with its own Payment Institution Licence authorised for operations across Europe by the Financial Supervisory Authority of Finland (FIN-FSA). Founded in Helsinki, Finland in 2011, the company was acquired in 2016 by BBVA.

rows.name: Impala
rows.short: Providing a Meta API for hotel PMS.
rows.description: Nearly all technology in a hotel must connect to the central property management system. The problem is there are thousands of these systems and connecting to each one takes months and is expensive. Impala solves this by providing a single, standard API to access hotel data. They connect in advance to the property management systems and then allow companies to connect to the data they need in minutes.

rows.name: Indoo.rs
rows.short: Advanced indoor mapping, localization, and routing technology.
rows.description: Indoo.rs (acquired by Esri in 2019) creates advanced indoor mapping, localization, and routing technology as well as an SDK for developers and device manufacturers. They allow end-users to accurately locate themselves and others inside buildings, such as an airport, shopping mall or exhibition center, using mobile devices. The company has developed various products for navigation, proximity, and asset tracking as well as navigations solutions for visually impaired people. Indoo.rs’ award-winning technology is being used to power navigation solutions at NYC’s Penn Station, serving more than 650,000 travelers each day, as well as in airport navigation applications to help the visually impaired find their way around.

rows.name: IndyKite
rows.short: Graph-powered data trust for enterprise AI.
rows.description: IndyKite is a San Francisco-based software company transforming enterprise AI with graph-powered solutions that bring trust, visibility, and control to complex data ecosystems. By connecting and governing data with precision, IndyKite enables secure, context-rich, and intelligent applications built on a foundation of trustworthy data.

rows.name: Inkitt
rows.short: Using AI to discover and publish potential hit novels from its global reading community.
rows.description: Inkitt is the world’s first data-powered book publisher, operating as a data-driven publishing house focused on discovering commercially successful fiction. The company operates a proprietary app where thousands of authors submit original stories, creating a large, diverse library of content across genres like romance, fantasy, and sci-fi. Inkitt's unique value is driven by its predictive algorithm, Galatea. This technology analyzes detailed reader engagement metrics—including reading speed, completion rates, and device interactions—to scientifically pinpoint stories with the highest potential for global success. This data-first system allows Inkitt to de-risk the publishing process and offer contracts to the most promising new authors.

rows.name: Invesdor
rows.short: Digital investment and financing platform for companies of all sizes.
rows.description: Invesdor Group combines the leading digital equity funding platform in the Nordics, Invesdor, and the leading digital mid-size (“Mittelstand”) financier in the German speaking countries, Finnest. The service portfolio spans from equity investments, bonds, IPO’s, syndicated loans, mezzanine capital and promissory notes to other debt capital instruments. Financing volumes typically range from EUR 250,000 to EUR 25m. Over the last years the combined and accumulated investments on the legacy platforms have doubled every year, currently totalling at more than EUR 130m. Invesdor Group holds a MiFID license passported to 28 European countries, which was granted to Invesdor in April 2015, making it the first such platform to receive this licence. The Group has a base of over 50,000 registered private and institutional investors from 150 countries.

rows.name: Investly
rows.short: SME access to working capital through invoice financing.
rows.description: Investly is an invoice discounting platform that allows SMEs to sell their invoices to investors, thereby increasing working capital. Invoices are sold in reverse auctions where investors place bids to ensure the best prices for merchants. The bidding system allows investors to earn above average returns. Investly’s service helps established businesses take on more customers, speed up their production process, and avoid seasonal cash flow gaps.

rows.name: IOMED
rows.short: Better ICD-10 coding and big data insights for hospitals.
rows.description: IOMED is a solution that helps understand free text from EHRs, letters, etc. to provide better ICD-10 coding and big data insights for hospitals, using sophisticated medical NLP and is seamlessly integrated into the existing IT landscape.

rows.name: Iyzico
rows.short: Offering vendors a fast and easy way to receive payments online.
rows.description: Iyzico (acquired by PayU in 2019) is Turkey’s leading ePayment company offering businesses easy solutions to accept payments online. The platform is tailored to the needs of the local market and integrates with over 22 different payment options and banks. Customers appreciate the easy setup process and features such as recurring payments and Iyzico’s marketplace solution.

rows.name: Joblocal
rows.short: Regional online job marketplaces in Germany and Austria.
rows.description: Joblocal (acquired by Funke Mediengruppe in 2014) is the first network of regional online job marketplaces in Germany and Austria. Unlike large national online job sites, joblocal connects potential candidates with relevant positions in their area. Their marketplaces cover the entire job market across all employee levels, from managers to temporary workers and interns. The company has built 34 local job marketplaces including jobs.sh, bglandJOBS.de, or MünchnerJOBS.de. Corporate customers recruiting talent on Joblocal’s marketplaces include companies like Marc O’Polo, Sixt, Ikea, and Intel.

rows.name: Julaya
rows.short: Enabling companies to perform all their financial transactions in one single interface.
rows.description: Julaya is a B2B digital account that enables companies to send and collect payments seamlessly through a digital account. With the Julaya platform, SME’s, large corporates and government institutions can make bulk payments through all mobile money channels, process their travel or online expenses with a corporate prepaid card, easily import all transactions into their accounting system, and digitize cash collection.

rows.name: Juli
rows.short: Improving life for people with chronic conditions.
rows.description: Juli integrates previously siloed data like data from smartphones and other wearables, environmental data and EHR data into one platform. All that data is analyzed to identify patterns and give recommendations that guide users towards better health. A patient-centric app allows the user to see their data in one dashboard, keep a journal, get reminders for their medication or be nudged towards micro-behavioural changes in a gamified way. juli is a SMART on FHIR platform that integrates easily into all kinds of health systems. This enables care providers to predict when a patient needs additional outreach to avoid a crisis and generates a common understanding of a patient's health status.

rows.name: Jumba
rows.short: B2B construction materials marketplace simplifying the supply chain in Africa.
rows.description: Headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya, Jumba is a construction technology company that is simplifying construction in Africa. Through its B2B marketplace, Jumba connects hardware stores and construction sites to manufacturers of construction materials. Launched in April 2022, Jumba serves customers in 60% of Kenya’s regions. The company is layering financial services through its bank partners to provide buy now pay later options for its customers.

rows.name: June
rows.short: Two-clicks product analytics for modern teams.
