rows.description: June lets you plug in your source of tracking and automatically generates the right product analyses for you. Before you had to come up with hypotheses and learn what to measure. With June, anyone without time or expertise can pick premade analyses straight away from a library of templates.

rows.name: Katch
rows.short: An anti-calendar product that gives us more time.
rows.description: Our mission is to save you time and allow you to optimize your time for what is most important. Blow up the calendar, starting with all those scheduled 1:1 meetings. Our goal is to change how we think about time. We want to remove the rigidity of the calendar and turn it into something more spontaneous, off-grid, and in the moment.

rows.name: Kema
rows.short: A cash flow platform helping MENA SMEs get paid faster, automate A/R, and unlock invoice financing seamlessly.
rows.description: Kema is revolutionizing how B2B SMEs in MENA manage their cash flow. By combining A/R automation, embedded payments, and invoice financing into one platform, the UAE-based startup empowers businesses to digitize collections, improve on-time payments, and unlock instant liquidity. With proprietary credit scoring built from ERP and payment data, Kema helps SMEs overcome late payments and limited financing access—long-standing barriers to growth in the region. By embedding itself at the core of the invoice-to-cash cycle, Kema is bridging the gap between fintech and everyday business operations. Kema facilities more than $50M in annual receivables, improves collections by up to 40% and streamlines collection processed by more than 50%. As MENA moves toward further digitization and a cashless economy, Kema is uniquely positioned to become the financial operating system for the region’s $3T B2B economy.

rows.name: KETS
rows.short: Leveraging the properties of quantum mechanics to solve challenging problems.
rows.description: A spin-out of the University of Bristol’s world-leading center in integrated photonics, KETS has developed a photonic integrated chip Quantum Key Distribution module that has lower size, weight, and power than all current other offerings. KETS is using integrated photonic technologies to offer practical, miniaturized and cost-effective solutions.

rows.name: Keyper
rows.short: Turning the GCC rental market into seamless digital infrastructure.
rows.description: Keyper is building the digital operating system for residential real estate in the GCC, bringing together rent payments, property management, landlord liquidity and embedded financial services in one platform. By digitising the rental journey end to end, Keyper is creating infrastructure for a more flexible, transparent and efficient real estate market.

rows.name: Khazna
rows.short: A financial benefits platform for employees, labor, and contractors.
rows.description: Khazna is a financial benefits platform that provides employees, labor, and contractors access to financial services. Starting with a lending and salary on demand offering, Khazna wants to become the go-to solution for any Egyptian when it comes to banking and lending solutions.

rows.name: Kittl
rows.short: Empowering creators to create complex designs faster and easier.
rows.description: Kittl provides a platform that makes complex design processes easier and faster. The new browser-based graphic design tool empowers anyone to become a creator and design logos, labels, postcards or anything else. Loaded with tons of templates, illustrations, and fonts, it offers endless design possibilities.

rows.name: Koalaboox
rows.short: Financing solution for SMEs, integrated into an easy-to-use e-invoicing software.
rows.description: Koalaboox's (acquired by Cegid in 2020) e-invoicing Software as a Service helps SMEs simplify their daily invoicing and accounting processes through tracking of revenues, expenses and payments - offering a one-click invoice financing solution built into the platform, allowing clients to fund invoices and solve their working capital needs.

rows.name: Koin
rows.short: Giving customers instant credit and installment payment options for online purchases.
rows.description: Koin (acquired by Despegar in 2020) is the only provider of after-delivery payment solutions in Latin America. The company offers safe and easy-to-use payment solutions to e-commerce shops that let buyers make purchases online and pay later. Koin offers online credit and instalment payment options to users with no need to fill out a registration or provide financial information. Their service helps e-commerce attract new buyer groups that previously have not been able to make payments online.

rows.name: Konfetti
rows.short: Building the leading platform for local workshops and events by empowering providers with customized SaaS solutions.
rows.description: More than a booking platform, konfetti enables suppliers to manage their business and increase their sales with an all-in-one software. In doing so, the company actively markets the classes. At the same time, the workshop provider has significantly less administrative work. Many processes that were previously handled offline or manually can now be handled through the konfetti platform. Billing and invoicing, is fully automated, tax compliant, and reduces unnecessary coordination with the company's own tax advisor. Launched in 2021 in Berlin, users can now find and book workshops in more than 250 cities. Hundreds of companies use konfetti as their go-to source for organizing and booking team events and corporate parties.

rows.name: Kraken
rows.short: Developing autonomous maritime defense systems.
rows.description: Kraken Technology Group is a British maritime technology company developing versatile, scalable uncrewed surface and subsurface platforms engineered to redefine modern maritime operations with high-performance, modular and production-ready systems. Its vessels fuse race-bred composite architecture, rapid prototyping, and autonomy, to meet current and future naval, security and commercial needs around the world.

rows.name: Kwest
rows.short: Renewable energy companies use Kwest to manage their installations end-to-end and automate their operations.
rows.description: Kwest (acquired by Kraken Technologies in 2024) was a platform helps you automate manual tasks, create visibility across your team and send data where you need it. With Kwest, you install and maintain assets more efficiently.

rows.name: Kyrok
rows.short: AI operating system for Europe’s industrial supply chains.
rows.description: Kyrok is building the AI operating system for Europe’s industrial backbone, starting with supply-chain teams in pharma and chemicals. Its industry-specific AI agents sit on top of existing ERP systems, turning fragmented data, manual workflows and expert knowledge into scalable processes, while keeping humans in control.

rows.name: Laelaps AI
rows.short: Building an agentic AI layer for real-world security and infrastructure protection.
rows.description: Laelaps AI develops a command, control, and orchestration layer that coordinates mobile robots and advanced sensors into a single autonomous response system. Designed for critical infrastructure and defence, Laelaps AI enables faster detection, smarter verification, and adaptive threat response through real-time coordination and shared risk mapping.

rows.name: Landvault
rows.short: Helping developers make money by connecting them to traditional ad networks.
rows.description: Landvault ( acquired by Infinite Reality in 2024 ) enables developers to create, manage and sell their AR/VR inventory in minutes, so they can focus on what they do best: creating great content. Landvault offers a plugin for Unity and Unreal Engine which allows normal ads to be displayed in VR/AR or gaming content, filter hundreds of advertisers via our programmatic platform and start generating revenue in minutes.

rows.name: Lapse
rows.short: For friends, not followers.
rows.description: Lapse is a photo-sharing platform that emulates the spontaneous experience of a disposable film camera to capture authentic, unedited moments. When a user snaps a picture, it enters a digital "darkroom" and develops over a few hours. This deliberate delay prevents editing and post-capture curation, ensuring all photos possess a spontaneous, natural aesthetic. The core mission of Lapse is to cultivate genuine, low-pressure connections, guided by our motto: "Friends, not Followers." The app is designed for intimate sharing, directing developed photos to small friend circles in a personalized "Journal" and intentionally removing public performance metrics like follower counts and likes.

rows.name: Ledgy
rows.short: Helping teams take the pain out of equity and share ownership.
rows.description: Ledgy helps companies build cultures of ownership. With Ledgy, companies can manage and automate key equity processes, saving time and money. Meanwhile, employees benefit from rich insights into their ownership, helping the whole team align around the company’s mission. Founded in Switzerland in 2017, Ledgy serves more than 2,500 customers in over 40 countries around the world.

rows.name: Lemonflow
rows.short: The AI infrastructure layer for operations in mobility.
rows.description: Lemonflow builds voice-based AI agents that automate customer support across EV charging and mobility. Purpose-built for the complexities of mobility infrastructure, Lemonflow’s agents deliver instant, multilingual support around the clock, resolving driver issues, triggering remote actions, and drastically cutting costs. Live with leading charge point operators across Europe, Lemonflow combines deep domain expertise with real-time system integrations to create a scalable support layer for the future of mobility.

rows.name: Lemonway
rows.short: Facilitating complex payments for digital platforms and e-commerce websites.
rows.description: Lemonway is a Pan-European Fintech startup dedicated to Crowdfunding platforms, e-commerce marketplaces and other companies looking for payment processing, wallet management and third-party payment in a KYC/AML-regulated framework. Lemonway’s technology solution and associated services enable banks to benefit from a very powerful real-time payment account management tool.

rows.name: Leta
rows.short: Helping businesses optimize the movement of goods to reduce costs and minimize climate impact.
rows.description: Built for Africa's unique logistics challenges, Leta’s AI-powered platform optimizes delivery routes, tracks shipments in real time, and streamlines payments while transforming shipment data into actionable insights. Since 2022, Leta has powered millions of deliveries, managed thousands of vehicles, and expanded from Kenya into Nigeria, Uganda, Zambia, and Zimbabwe—working with brands like KFC, EABL, and Chandaria Industries.

rows.name: Lizee
rows.short: Enabling brands and retailers to launch circular rental services.
rows.description: Lizee is building a more sustainable retail industry by helping brands adapt their businesses to include a rental service. The Lizee Rental Lab makes the process simple and hassle free by first optimizing the brands existing eCommerce site for renting. The team then handles the picking, packing, shipping and facilitation of payments for rented products, oversees quality checks for returned products, refurbishing, and more. Lizee does the heavy lifting and retailers reap the financial rewards.

rows.name: LizzyAI
rows.short: Recruiting platform that uses AI-powered interviews to help companies hire faster, fairer, and more efficiently.
rows.description: Founded in the USA by serial entrepreneur Yannis Niebelschütz, Lizzy AI is a next-generation recruiting platform that uses AI-powered, structured interviews to streamline and standardize hiring. The platform automatically generates interview questions, conducts assessments, and delivers clear, comparable scoring to reduce bias and accelerate decisions. Companies use Lizzy AI to evaluate candidates more objectively and at scale, while significantly reducing recruiter workload. The result: faster hiring, better talent matches, and an improved candidate experience.

rows.name: Luko
rows.short: Reinventing home insurance.
rows.description: Launched in May 2018, and acquired by Admiral Group in 2023, Luko’s revolutionary home insurance is simple: customers get covered in 2 minutes, claims paid in 2 hours, and repairman’s visit your home in 2 days. Offering a new transparent and responsible model, Luko transforms insurance core business model to align the interests of the tenant and the insurer. The company provides AI and ‘plug&play’ smart devices that monitor consumptions in order to identify and prevent disasters, such as flooding, fire and burglary.

rows.name: Maqsad
rows.short: Building a personalized learning platform to make high-quality education accessible to 100 million Pakistani students.
rows.description: Maqsad is a mobile-first edtech platform that delivers high-quality personalized academic content for 100 million Pakistani students. The platform provides a holistic learning experience where users can learn a concept, test their knowledge, and ask questions. The edtech has developed the MENAP region's first instant query-solving engine, which matches student queries to video solutions within seconds. In just the last 6 months, Maqsad has reached over 1 million students and answered 4 million plus student queries. The platform is building AI-enabled tools to increase personalization, adaptive learning, and build a data-driven ecosystem to improve learning outcomes.

rows.name: Meisterwerk
rows.short: Automating job and resource planning for SME craftsmen and construction companies.
rows.description: Craftsmen and construction companies face a huge challenge managing their resources in a highly dynamic environment. Meisterwerk provides an easy to use SaaS solution, which makes planning and coordination processes between offices and construction sites more efficient. The software enables their customers to track the status and progress of their jobs and resources in real-time, increase overall profitability, and unlock growth potential for their companies.

rows.name: Mercanis
rows.short: Scaling procurement excellence through our AI-powered platform solutions.
rows.description: Simplify and automate your procurement procedures and processes.

rows.name: Metis Labs
rows.short: Using AI to maximize industrial efficiency and cut waste.
rows.description: On a daily basis, large industrial processes face problems related to operational inefficiencies and low yields. The resulting waste adds significantly to their operating costs, production capacity, and environmental footprint. Metis Labs ( aquired by Ascalia in 2024 ) offers a unique and valuable solution. The company has created an intelligent software application capable of adapting itself to the characteristics of any industrial production process and improving operational efficiency.

rows.name: Metrilo
rows.short: Tailored to the needs of e-commerce websites.
rows.description: Metrilo (acquired by Brevo in 2021) is a suite of analytics and marketing tools for eCommerce websites. It helps merchants track key performance indicators (KPIs), analyze trends, and make data-driven decisions to increase retention, conversion and sales performance. Metrilo’s CRM platform also allows webshops to send highly targeted email campaigns and to measure their success rates. The company's software is easy to install and integrates with all major e-commerce platforms such as Woocommerce, Shopify, or Magento. As of January 2018 the company has hit over $100MM USD in total sales generated with their email automation and segmentation tools alone.

rows.name: Mews
rows.short: The hospitality management platform powering modern hotels.
rows.description: Speedinvest became a shareholder in Mews following its acquisition of Flexkeeping in 2025. Mews is a property management system designed to streamline and automate hotel operations. By integrating reservations, front desk, payments, guest experience, and back-office workflows into a single platform, Mews enables hospitality operators to increase efficiency, unlock new revenue streams, and deliver a seamless guest journey. Through its acquisition of Flexkeeping, Mews expanded its operational capabilities beyond property management, helping hospitality teams manage housekeeping, maintenance, guest requests, and internal workflows more efficiently.

rows.name: MiLaboratories
rows.short: The leader in immunome data analysis software with flagship product MiXCR.
rows.description: MiLaboratories is the leader in immunome data analysis software with flagship product MiXCR, a top-notch solution to analyze immunology sequencing data. Our software is used in vaccine, cancer, antibodies, and autoimmune diseases drug development pipelines. We provide a secure, scalable, and fast solution that helps thousands of researchers around the globe to discover new drugs and therapies.

rows.name: Milano Vice
rows.short: Germany's first virtual restaurant chain.
rows.description: Founded in Berlin in 2022, Milano Vice is an amplifier for partner restaurants, traditional bakeries, and professional chefs. Milano Vice partners can triple partners' sales thanks to resource optimization through increased utilization of kitchen and staff. It targets Gen Y and Z customers through its innovative branding and provides state-of-the-art technology to its partner restaurants.

rows.name: Mimic Robotics
rows.short: AI-powered dexterous robots for complex industrial tasks.
rows.description: Zurich-based Mimic is a physical AI company enabling robots to perform complex, human-level dexterous tasks autonomously. Its AI foundation model and humanoid robotic hands bring human-like manipulation to real-world industrial use cases. By combining advanced AI, scalable hardware, and a novel solution to robotics data scarcity, Mimic lays the groundwork for the next generation of intelligent automation.

rows.name: MindsDB
rows.short: Improves the predictive power of your data.
rows.description: MindsDB helps organizations use machine learning and artificial intelligence to obtain predictive insights that can allow them to make better business decisions. MindsDB trains, tests and then selects the most accurate state of the art AI models to apply to your data allowing for accurate predictions and forecasting.

rows.name: MinersAI
rows.short: Geological data platform and marketplace for mineral exploration companies.
rows.description: The need for critical minerals is expected to grow up to 40x in the next 20 years, and discovered reserves are far too low to meet demand. Mineral Exploration needs to be deployed at scale to identify new deposits, in geographies where ESG standards are well enforced. MinersAI is focused on the early-stage part of mineral exploration: before prospectors even identify a target. Customers can save years in finding, acquiring and processing the data they need to make expensive targeting decisions in their Minerals Exploration Projects, thanks to innovative data management, exchange and AI tools.

rows.name: Mistral
rows.short: The European AI company building frontier models, AI products, and developer infrastructure.
rows.description: Speedinvest became a shareholder in Mistral AI following its acquisition of Emmi AI in 2026. Mistral AI is a European AI company building frontier models, AI products, and infrastructure for developers, enterprises, and public-sector organizations. Its products include Le Chat and La Plateforme, helping users and organizations build with advanced AI. Through its acquisition of Emmi AI, Mistral AI is expanding its capabilities in physics AI for industrial and scientific customers.

rows.name: Molecule
rows.short: Connecting life science research to funding.
rows.description: Molecule is creating collaborative ecosystems, where stakeholders in drug development can work together to expedite the process of bringing novel therapeutics to patients - connecting leading researchers to funding by turning intellectual property and its development into a liquid and easily investable asset.

rows.name: MoonPay
rows.short: The global infrastructure for seamless crypto payments.
rows.description: Speedinvest became a shareholder in MoonPay following its acquisition of Iron in 2025. MoonPay is a financial technology platform enabling individuals and businesses to buy, sell, and manage digital assets through simple, compliant, and user-friendly on- and off-ramps. By integrating payments, identity verification, and regulatory infrastructure into a single experience, MoonPay powers access to the crypto economy for users and enterprises worldwide. Through its acquisition of Iron, MoonPay expanded its stablecoin infrastructure capabilities, helping enterprises move, store, and manage digital dollars more seamlessly across the global crypto economy.

rows.name: Moove
rows.short: Building the operating layer for autonomous mobility.
rows.description: Moove is an African-born global mobility company building the operating layer for autonomous mobility. Headquartered in the UAE and founded in 2020 by Ladi Delano and Jide Odunsi, Moove finances, owns and operates productive mobility assets for leading mobility platforms across manned and autonomous transportation. Since its launch, the company has expanded across international markets and built a significant global fleet and workforce. Moove is a major global fleet partner to Uber and operates autonomous vehicle fleets through its partnership with Waymo. In autonomous mobility, Moove finances, owns and operates autonomous vehicles, builds and manages robotics-first Nest infrastructure, and provides the operational capabilities required to deploy driverless services at scale. Its autonomous operations are expanding across the US and international markets.

rows.name: Mophones
rows.short: Device-financing and recommerce platform expanding affordable access to quality electronics.
rows.description: Founded in Kenya, MoPhones is building an accessible device-financing and recommerce infrastructure for Africa, starting with refurbished smartphones and flexible payment plans. The company addresses a structural gap in affordable device access while extending the lifecycle of existing hardware. By formalizing a fragmented market and reducing upfront costs for consumers, MoPhones is creating a scalable entry point into digital inclusion and circular tech across the continent.

rows.name: Mpiriq
rows.short: MPIRIQ links everyday clinical data with medical research to turn routine patient care into insights that accelerate new therapies.
rows.description: Built as an AI-powered infrastructure, MPIRIQ’s platform connects real-world healthcare data from daily medical practice with researchers and pharma partners. By automatically structuring clinical information and enabling secure, privacy-preserving data exchange, it turns everyday patient encounters into actionable evidence for faster medical innovation. This continuous loop between care and research reduces documentation burdens for clinicians, improves data access for scientists, and accelerates the development of new therapies. The result: better care, better research, and progress that benefits everyone.

rows.name: Mundi
rows.short: Treasury-as-a-Service platform for companies without dedicated treasury teams to optimize funds in high-yield, low-risk financial products.
rows.description: Mundi simplifies access to high-yield savings accounts by connecting users to 15+ Turkish banks through a single investment platform. With one-click access to overnight and long-term savings accounts for TRY and FX deposits, Mundi enables effortless, automated working capital management. Beyond savings accounts, users can dynamically allocate funds to low-risk financial products, including money market funds (MMFs) and overnight repo agreements, all within Mundi’s seamless investment platform.

rows.name: MyClubs
rows.short: Flexible fitness subscription.
rows.description: MyClubs ( acquired by Urban Sports Club in 2024 ) is a flexible fitness subscription that gives members access to various gyms, yoga studios, and many other workout providers across Austria and Switzerland. Users can choose between different subscription models and use the complimentary myClubs app to check in to classes. MyClub also offers a solution for corporate fitness which lets companies provide MyClubs memberships to their employees as part of their employee benefits packages. Since the company’s foundation in 2014, MyClubs has grown into the leading sports aggregator in Austria and Switzerland with over 1,200 exclusive contractual partners.

rows.name: MyDataModels
rows.short: MyDataModels believes that Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Data Science should be open and available all.
rows.description: MyDataModels is the developer of TADA, an analytics platform powered by Artificial Intelligence . Powerful and easy to use, TADA helps companies analyze and extract value from data. The platform generates highly interpretable and accurate predictive models, and contrary to traditional machine learning methods, the solution works with small data sets. No coding or data science expertise are required! French-based MyDataModels' unique technology is the preferred solution for healthcare, research, industry and embedded systems.

rows.name: NECTURE
rows.short: Building a world where electric fleets are not only possible, but thrive.
rows.description: Necture (formerly Ubiq) empowers businesses to unlock the full potential of fleets, seamlessly bridging the gap between mobility and energy. Combining human-driven information with data-driven intelligence, we provide tailored solutions that optimize operations, reduce costs, and achieve sustainability goals. Our AI-driven technology platform offers advanced data analytics, automation, and user experience for efficient fleet management. Going beyond mere intelligence, we translate data into real-world actions, minimizing environmental impact and driving a cleaner, greener future.

rows.name: NeoCarbon
rows.short: Capturing carbon directly from the atmosphere at scale to profitably leverage the existing airflow and waste heat of industrial cooling towers.
rows.description: NeoCarbon reverses climate change by dramatically cutting the costs associated with Direct Air Capture. By retrofitting existing cooling towers without impacting their original function, the time and cost investment needed to set up a carbon capturing system is reduced by up to 10x.

rows.name: NeuroHarmonics
rows.short: Building the future of non-invasive neuromodulation using focused ultrasound to modulate deep brain circuits safely.
rows.description: NeuroHarmonics is pioneering the future of brain health through a revolutionary platform that unites surgical-level precision with at-home accessibility. Using proprietary focused ultrasound technology, their wearable headset can safely modulate deep brain circuits to treat neurological and psychiatric conditions—transforming neuromodulation from an expensive, invasive procedure into scalable, continuous therapy.

rows.name: Nilo Health
rows.short: The mental well-being support for your entire workforce.
rows.description: nilo.health makes high-quality mental health support easily accessible for everyone, enabling employers to conveniently and effectively offer mental health services as a company benefit. Through its evidence-based and confidential platform, nilo.health provides employees with the right level of care based on their individual needs: the support ranges from 1 on 1 sessions with psychologists to group sessions and digital, self-guided tools.

rows.name: Nofence
rows.short: The world’s first commercial virtual fencing system for livestock.
rows.description: Nofence’s virtual fencing system combines solar-powered, GPS-enabled collars connected via cellular network to an easy-to-use app, allowing farmers to create and adjust virtual grazing boundaries from their phone, enabling real-time tracking and responsive herd management. When an animal approaches the boundary, the collar emits sounds that gradually increase in pitch, prompting it to change direction. If the animal continues forward, it receives a mild electric pulse designed to be half as intense as traditional electric fences. Over time, the majority of interactions are resolved with sound alone, resulting in calmer, more predictable grazing behaviour. This innovation replaces the need for physical fencing, reducing infrastructure and maintenance costs, labour, and environmental impact. By giving farmers greater control over how and where their livestock graze, Nofence helps improve soil health, prevents overgrazing, and supports regenerative land management practices, particularly in remote or environmentally sensitive areas.

rows.name: Nomos
rows.short: Helping hardware companies launch electricity plans by abstracting all legal and operational complexity into a simple API layer.
rows.description: With a growing consumer appetite for energy self-sufficiency, smart heating, and charging solutions, homeowners increasingly demand full-service offerings, going beyond hardware installation and optimization, and including dynamic electricity plans to take full advantage of price fluctuations. Nomos addresses this need by providing OEMs and installers with an easy-to-integrate API solution for dynamic electricity plans. Acting as a licensed electricity retailer on the European electricity exchange market (EPEX SPOT), Nomos takes care of all legal and operational complexity, enabling its B2B clients to offer comprehensive energy solutions without upfront costs and operational effort.

rows.name: Nook
rows.short: Helping accountants and businesses manage their payments and payroll.
rows.description: Accounting software can't pay your bills. Banks don't know which bills to pay. Nook integrates both to give you payment perfection.

rows.name: Octav
rows.short: Know your cost-basis at all times and make better decisions.
rows.description: Octav is an all-in-one platform that fills major financial information gaps by providing its users with valuable financial data, including cost basis and P&L of all their assets and NFTs on major chains. Investors also have the freedom to easily edit their inaccurate transactions, and manage their portfolio by using in-house tools to interact with the web3 ecosystem, such as buying, selling, claiming or compounding their assets directly on the platform.

rows.name: Ona
rows.short: Redefining how engineers build software through AI-driven autonomy and secure cloud environments.
rows.description: Ona (acquired by OpenAI in 2026) is a software development platform where teams create, delegate, and review code alongside autonomous engineering agents. Its API-first, sandboxed environments offer OS-level isolation, secure management of code and secrets, and full compatibility with VS Code—both in browser and mobile. What makes Ona unique is its team of agents, which automate routine tasks, boost productivity, and enable parallel development. Enterprise users benefit from bank-grade security, private infrastructure deployment, and granular policy controls, ideal for organizations needing compliance and speed in their workflows.

rows.name: one-five
rows.short: Transforming material science inventions into sustainable packaging products.
rows.description: Sustainable packaging alternatives are usually very expensive to deploy at full market scale as the products are not mature enough yet. one • fıve tackles this problem of scalability by transforming existing academic lab-scale material science inventions into market-ready solutions that are economically viable and meet the rising demand of conscious consumers. They systematically discover promising - but not yet mature - research results from renowned universities and research institutes. Researchers at one • fıve further develop this IP in their own 5,000 m² R&D campus near Hamburg, Germany. The facility includes algae cultivation, processing, fermentation capacity, a laboratory, a prototype workshop and testing facilities, giving them the necessary infrastructure to further develop these technologies from a previous proof of concept into a market-ready proof of scalability.

rows.name: Onepot
rows.short: AI-native, fully automated synthesis platform that produces billions of molecules at ultra-high throughput.
rows.description: San-Francisco-based onepot is reimagining chemistry by combining ultra-high-throughput lab automation with AI to deliver true end-to-end chemical synthesis at the scale of billions of molecules. By giving scientists instant, automated access to molecules, the company aims to eliminate pharma’s reliance on CROs and slow, error-prone synthesis workflows. Their AI-native, fully automated platform brings chemical synthesis closer, faster, and with unprecedented technical reliability.

rows.name: One Trading
rows.short: Providing experienced traders, finance professionals, and institutions with regulated and secure access to digital assets.
rows.description: One Trading, formerly Bitpanda Pro, is a European digital asset exchange made for experienced traders, finance professionals and institutions. Safe, regulated and intuitive, they offer over 50 tokens to deliver deep EUR, GBP and CHF liquidity at a competitive rate. As well as their high performance spot exchange, they also have an OTC desk.

rows.name: OneTrust
rows.short: Helping companies manage privacy, consent, and AI governance to reduce risk, build trust, and drive innovation.
rows.description: Speedinvest became a shareholder in OneTrust following its acquisition of Planetly in 2021. OneTrust builds the Trust Intelligence Platform – connecting privacy, GRC, ethics, and ESG teams, data, and processes – so companies big and small can collaborate seamlessly and put trust at the center of their operations and culture. Helping companies and supply chains measure and track ESG initiatives, OneTrust empowers ethical cultures so companies can uphold the highest standards of trust.

rows.name: Onit
rows.short: Building your bank, free from hidden fees.
rows.description: OnIt, a licensed bank in Kenya, offers a free transaction network linking consumers, businesses, and suppliers, enhanced with services like check-out finance, premium financial products, and open APIs for easy consumer integration.

rows.name: Opal
rows.short: Become indistractable.
rows.description: Some companies specialize in stealing our time on screens, using features like notifications, infinite scrolling, A.I. curated feeds, subconscious triggers and disappearing stories. Opal helps you take control of your technology, so you can regain time that's been stolen from you. Their app identifies and blocks distractions, allows you to set screen timers, personal intentions for your time, and receive personalized nudges to help you find balance each day.

rows.name: open
rows.short: Digital business account and expense management tools for SMEs and startups.
rows.description: Open is a business banking platform that combines everything from invoicing to banking, payroll and automated accounting in one place. It also offers the best of the classic banking services like (internet banking, cheque books, Debit card) along with these additional features.

rows.name: OpenAI
rows.short: The AI research and deployment company behind ChatGPT and Codex.
rows.description: Speedinvest became a shareholder in OpenAI following its acquisition of Ona in 2026. OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company building AI systems, products, and infrastructure used by individuals, developers, and enterprises around the world. Its products include ChatGPT and Codex, with Codex helping software teams build, review, and improve code with AI. Through its acquisition of Ona, OpenAI is expanding Codex with secure, customer-controlled cloud infrastructure for long-running software agents.

rows.name: opus
rows.short: Multi-agent operating system for industrial supply chains.
rows.description: Opus builds AI agents for operational procurement, helping industrial companies automate the full procure-to-pay process with greater speed, accuracy, and control. The platform turns unstructured inputs such as emails, PDFs, Word documents, and Excel files into decision-ready data, supports context-based decisions, and executes workflows across ERP systems and supplier communications. By combining automation with process memory that improves over time, Opus helps teams reduce manual work, mitigate supply and margin risk, and unlock measurable efficiency gains across procurement operations.

rows.name: Orakl Oncology
rows.short: Leveraging patient tumor avatars to transform drug development in oncology.
rows.description: Cancer complexity leads to a 96% failure rate of drug candidates in clinical trials and a shortage of new treatments. Orakl Oncology’s ambition is to finally address the heterogeneity of cancer and patient specificities as early as possible in drug development. By creating a collection of avatars of patients’ tumors, they predict how each patient will respond to future drugs, combining best-in-class biology with deep clinical data and machine learning to efficiently discover and optimize new treatments for the right patients.

rows.name: ORUS
rows.short: Delivering hyperspectral satellite imagery at scale, improving environmental accountability, public policy, and security worldwide.
rows.description: ORUS’ mission is to deliver high-resolution hyperspectral space imagery with native precision and fidelity, enabling accurate identification of objects and environments based on their chemical composition and surface conditions, at scale. This is achieved through a commercial microsatellite imagery constellation and interpretation, thanks to ORUS’ proprietary automatic processing technologies, which enable the unprecedented exploitation of large volumes of data and the classification of chemicals and materials. For the first time, ORUS will deliver a combination of data resolution and information reliability that enables effective public policy enforcement, strengthens security, and supports corporate environmental accountability and business sustainability.

rows.name: Ozé
rows.short: Empowering African micro-SMEs to grow and scale.
rows.description: Despite merchants and micro-SMEs forming the pillars on which West African economies stand, these businesses have been overwhelmingly ignored and neglected by mobile-based financial service providers. Ozé helps capture, analyze and improve the performance of business owners in Ghana and Nigeria with the ambition to become a pan-African player. Through their digital accounting system, which enables users to keep track of their records, AR and AP and get access to credit, Ozé users are able to operate like large businesses and, therefore, empowers micro-SMEs to grow and scale far beyond their current reach. Having partnered with the region’s biggest banks, SME banks and local fintechs, Ozé is able to provide its users with products from traditional financial institutions but with the seamless interface and usability of a social media platform.

rows.name: Pace Revenue
rows.short: Hospitality revenue management platform utilizing machine learning and statistical modelling.
rows.description: Pace (acquired by FlyrLabs in 2022) was founded to change revenue management and help companies be more effective in their distribution and sales - empowering them to make better use of resources, generate less waste, and contribute to a better world.

rows.name: Packhelp
rows.short: Enabling businesses to offer customers the best unboxing experience possible.
rows.description: Packhelp allows its clients to quickly design and order custom packaging. A very user-friendly box editor, revolutionary low minimum order size and fast, high-quality production are the reasons why Packhelp’s services are being used by both small e-commerce entrepreneurs and multinational corporations. Packhelp’s mission is to enable every company – regardless of its size – to offer the best unboxing experience possible. Customers can expect new products and services that will push their packaging experience to the next level.

rows.name: Palm
rows.short: Enabling treasury teams to strategically move money between hundreds of bank accounts and local subsidiaries.
rows.description: Palm is a financial technology company created to streamline cash management for enterprise treasury teams. Built with enterprise-grade security and controls, the company’s Treasury Operating System provides corporate treasurers with the data and advisory to quickly understand and free up operational cash and automate workflows for forecasting and cash positioning.

rows.name: PalmHR
rows.short: Simply a better HR experience.
rows.description: A SaaS based platform for businesses, palm.hr fully automates HR management to transform employee experiences. Founded in 2019 in Riyadh, palm.hr ’s innovative technology is designed to elevate HR functioning with a number of solutions to create efficiencies for businesses.

rows.name: Paradox
rows.short: Replacing fragmented tools with an AI-powered platform that unifies organizational intelligence and enables aligned decision-making.
rows.description: Paradox is building a new kind of organizational intelligence — one that addresses a simple but costly truth: most leaders have little real-time insight into what’s happening across their companies. Despite layers of tools, meetings, and reports, strategic clarity often breaks down as companies scale. Teams pull in different directions, decisions drift, and precious time is lost chasing alignment that never quite clicks. Ironically, the systems meant to bring order often add more complexity, not less. That’s the paradox being solved. Instead of stacking yet another tool on top, Paradox has developed an AI-powered reasoning layer that connects the dots across the business — surfacing hidden constraints, tracking strategic flow, and ensuring the right people get the right information at the right time.

rows.name: Paua
rows.short: Building the universal electric vehicle charging solution for businesses.
rows.description: Paua supports getting more people into electric vehicles by harmonizing the fragmented landscape of electric vehicle chargepoints. Through aggregating smart connected electric vehicle charging infrastructure, we enable a transition to cleaner transport. We use technology to provide drivers with the latest chargepoint status, to enable direct integration to start a charge and we aggregate all the costs into one bill. All of our charging is guaranteed backed by renewable energy. One app, one card, one bill, thousands of chargepoints and zero emissions.

rows.name: Payworks
rows.short: Next generation Point of Sale payment gateway technology for merchants.
rows.description: Payworks (acquired by VISA) was the provider of Pulse, a next generation Point of Sale payment gateway technology. With Pulse, developers of Point of Sale solutions for merchants can quickly and cost-efficiently integrate card payment functionality into their applications, and securely process EMV; contactless and mobile wallet transactions at the Point of Sale.

rows.name: Pemo
rows.short: Corporate cards and all-in-one spend management for SMEs in MENAP.
rows.description: Pemo is a UAE-based startup on a mission to empower small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) across the Middle East, North Africa and Pakistan (MENAP) region by offering an all-in-one spend management platform that includes prepaid corporate cards, invoice payment systems and expense tracking functions. The company aims to remove friction in day-to-day spending processes, allowing businesses to entrust their teams to make quicker and more responsible purchasing decisions. In addition to accounting automation, virtual and physical cards with built-in rules and the consolidation of inbound invoices, Pemo’s software offers an integrated dashboard with full visibility over company spending and real-time tracking and reporting options.

rows.name: Perk
rows.short: The intelligent platform for travel and spend management.
rows.description: Speedinvest became a shareholder in Perk following its acquisition of Yokoy in 2025. Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is an AI-native platform built to eliminate “shadow work” – the invisible, manual tasks such as filing expenses, coding invoices, and chasing approvals that drain employee productivity. By unifying travel booking, expense management, and corporate payments into a single, seamless experience, Perk enables companies worldwide to save time and refocus on their core business. Through its acquisition of Yokoy, Perk expanded beyond travel management into AI-powered spend management, helping companies automate expenses, invoices, approvals, and corporate payments in one platform.

rows.name: Pimloc
rows.short: Deep learning services for video security and data privacy applications.
rows.description: Pimloc is a British tech company which provides specialist deep learning services for video security and data privacy applications. It has developed a world leading platform for the ingestion, detection, classification, and protection of image and video content. The Pimloc platform has been trained by showing it millions of images across a wide range of content. It has learned how to recognize and classify faces, objects, and even scenes in images it has never seen before.

rows.name: Planetly
rows.short: Building the easiest tools for your business to analyse, reduce and offset your carbon footprint.
rows.description: Planetly (acquired by OneTrust in 2021) is a climate-tech-company developing digital tools enabling companies to analyze, reduce and compensate their Co2 emissions. By completely automating the process of data acquisition, Planetly provides real-time analysis of the carbon footprint and the required transparency and tools reduce it. Planetly was founded by Berlin serial entrepreneurs Anna Alex and Benedikt Franke in January 2020.

rows.name: planqc
rows.short: Building quantum computers from individual atoms to achieve massive scale.
rows.description: planqc was founded 2022 by a team of scientists from the Max-Planck-Institute of Quantum Optics and Ludwig-Maximilians-University Munich and is the first startup to emerge from the Munich Quantum Valley, one of the leading quantum technology hubs in Europe. planqc’s quantum computers are built on the precision of the world’s best atomic clocks, the world’s best quantum gas microscopes, and high-speed Rydberg gates. This unique combination of quantum technologies is the fastest way to scale to thousands of qubits, a prerequisite for industry-relevant quantum advantage.

rows.name: Platypus
rows.short: Talent lifecycle management solution for HR managers.
rows.description: Platypus is the HR tech solution that helps HR professionals measure what people value at every stage of the talent lifecycle, from attraction to management to retention. Its solution equips managers with the right data collected from every single employee in order to meet their needs and prepare themselves for future business challenges. With its value-centric approach to company culture they have identified 12 work-related values, corresponding to 3 core areas of organizational culture, that provide unique insights into individuals’ needs and priorities while protecting their anonymity.

rows.name: Playbrush
rows.short: Gamifying children’s teeth brushing routine.
rows.description: Playbrush (aquired by Sunstar Global in 2021) is a London and Vienna-based technology company that digitizes oral care for children. With Playbrush, boring brushing routines suddenly become an exciting adventure. The colorful, smart toothbrush attachment fits onto the handle of any manual toothbrush so kids control planes, paint masterpieces and win dance battles via their brushing movements. Personalized feedback, statistics and brushing rewards mean brushing is now not only fun, but also effective. The Playbrush comes with a variety of games, a data monitoring application for parents and regular toothbrush and toothpaste supplies.

rows.name: Pliant
rows.short: A B2B payments platform built to meet the needs of high-growth businesses and embedded finance players.
rows.description: Pliant empowers businesses worldwide with streamlined B2B payment solutions. Designed to serve industries with complex, high-volume payment needs - like travel and ecommerce - Pliant's platform allows companies to issue cards, access credit lines, and payment features directly into their workflows. With seamless integrations, white-labeling options, and real-time APIs, Pliant enables full-stack control of business payments and reconciliation.

rows.name: Plural AI
rows.short: The first dedicated research platform to enable better business and financial analysis.
rows.description: Plural AI has built an AI-powered Knowledge Workbench that helps you aggregate and organize all your information, to generate complex insights, improve your research workflows, and make better investment decisions. Plural AI is setting the standard in knowledge work augmentation and workflow automation; the company aims to redefine the way people search, interact, and manipulate data at scale. The long term vision is to become the default interface for knowledge work, enabling business users to access complex data science without knowing how to code.

rows.name: Polaron
rows.short: Building an AI-first platform to connect process, structure, and performance in materials science.
rows.description: Polaron translates microscopy images into actionable insight, revealing how microstructure links manufacturing processes to material performance. By automating characterisation and enabling generative design, the platform helps engineers optimise production and develop higher-performing materials across metals, ceramics, polymers, and composites.

rows.name: Porotech
rows.short: Developing high-performance and energy-efficient multifunctional GaN semiconductor wafers.
rows.description: Porotech is revolutionizing the semiconducting industry thanks to its multifunctional GaN semiconductor wafers. Their proprietary technology and unique production process allow for the creation of porous semiconductor materials and structures with enhanced behavior. GaN has important photonic properties which allow it to be used in LEDs and microLEDS, as well as energy efficient properties which have important applications in RF and power devices.

rows.name: Precium
rows.short: The first African payments platform purpose-built for enterprise.
rows.description: Precium (formerly Revio) is the first African payments platform purpose-built for enterprise. Industry leaders choose Precium to optimise payment performance, automate financial operations, and craft extraordinary customer experiences. Founded in 2020 by Ruaan Botha and Nicole Dunn, Precium aims to combat the impact of payment fragmentation and failure on consumer commerce in African markets. Its unified payments platform offers merchants access to locally-optimised payment methods, with built-in redundancy and routing rules to increase payment success rates. Beyond payment acceptance, Precium offers a suite of configurable payment operations and recovery solutions – such as automated reconciliation, monitoring, and alerting – to help enterprise merchants reduce payment complexity. The growing list of Precium customers includes South Africa’s largest retailers and financial institutions, and some of the world’s largest consumer brands. The company partners with its clients to deliver payment solutions that enable quantifiable business value with the scalability, reliability, and flexibility required for high-volume processing.

rows.name: Prewave
rows.short: Predicting supply chain and sustainability risks.
rows.description: Prewave is an Austrian-based AI company that specializes in supply chain risk intelligence and monitoring for global enterprises. The platform continuously monitors and analyzes massive amounts of public and non-public data, including news, social media, and industry reports, to predict supply chain disruptions before they occur. The company transforms unstructured data into actionable, real-time alerts for risks like geopolitical events, factory fires, labor disputes, and sustainability violations anywhere in a company’s multi-tier supply network.

rows.name: Primer
rows.short: Helping online merchants power the best commerce experiences in the world.
rows.description: Primer aims to unify and supercharge merchants’ fragmented payments ecosystems through a single platform. By delivering data-driven insights across our entire merchant-base, Primer can optimize front and back-end payment flows in order to increase authorization rates, reduce costs, expand into new markets and deliver leading-edge commerce experiences to customers.

rows.name: PurposeGreen
rows.short: End-to-end solution for energy CAPEX and long-term ESG management.
rows.description: One-stop-shop transforming investment properties into sustainable assets, providing energy audits, green subsidies & financing, and construction project execution combined with smart ESG & energy intelligence. By combining technology with actually touching the building, Purpose aims to become the EU-wide executive branch and digital control center of reaching the 1.5°C decarbonisation goal.

rows.name: Qovery
rows.short: The simplest way to deploy your applications on AWS.
rows.description: Qovery simplifies the process of getting apps into production by pushing code from Github or GitLab and deploying it directly to AWS, Digital Ocean, or Scaleway instantly. The company abstracts away all the complexity that comes with deployment and at the same time combines the power of Kubernetes, the reliability of AWS, and the simplicity of Heroku.

rows.name: QphoX
rows.short: Allowing quantum computers to be networked together.
rows.description: QphoX’s proprietary quantum transducer coherently translates quantum information from the microwave to the optical domain, allowing for quantum processing units to be connected, scaled up, and used in quantum networks. Their solutions allow for small, high-fidelity quantum processors to be connected into a large, parallel quantum processing unit for more powerful distributed computation.

rows.name: Rainbow
rows.short: Issuing high-quality, verifiable carbon credits from industrial GreenTech SMEs in Europe.
rows.description: Rainbow (formerly Riverse) has developed a carbon credit standard and a digital Measurement, Reporting and Verification (MRV) platform, enabling industrial GreenTech SMEs in Europe to issue carbon credits to earn money. The solution makes it possible to issue carbon credits 20 times faster and at a cost 3 times lower than current market standards. Founded in France in 2021, Rainbow aims to bring transparency and unlock high-quality supply on the carbon markets, in order to accelerate the financing of high-impact decarbonisation technologies in Europe.

rows.name: Raus
rows.short: Creating getaways with smart, sustainable cabins near major cities.
rows.description: Raus is a hospitality-tech startup that offers city-dwellers new opportunities to take a break from big city life with perfectly simple cabins, close enough for a spontaneous getaway, far enough to completely unwind. Founded in 2021 by school friends Christopher Eilers, Johann Ahlers and Julian Trautwein in Berlin, Raus' mission is to provide seamless access to restful space outside your daily routine. Industry-leading VCs and angel investors backing Raus include venture capital firm Speedinvest, Tourlane founders, Julian Stiefel and Julian Weselek, former Airbnb Managing Director (Europe, Middle East and Africa) and Zazume Co-Founder, Jeroen Merchiers, and BCG Digital Ventures Managing Director & Partner, Urs Rahne, among others.

rows.name: ready2order
rows.short: Transforming every smartphone, tablet, and PC into a fully functional cash register.
rows.description: ready2order (acquired by Zucchetti Group in 2023) offers a multi-award winning, cloud-based point-of-sale solution that transforms every smartphone, tablet and PC into a fully functional cash register. Companies that use ready2order have access to a range of awesome tools that are more powerful and easier to use than enterprise systems – but only for a fraction of the cost.

rows.name: receeve
rows.short: Fully digital debt-servicing platform for the entire collection lifecycle.
rows.description: Receeve is turning the current way of collecting debt upside down, by using AI to provide personalized collections and replace the outdated process of lenders using phone calls or letters to reach indebted clients. With Receeve, firms can communicate with their customers digitally, on any device, and customers have the option of self-service to manage their issues. The platform covers the entire collections lifecycle from managing receivables to servicing NPL portfolios.

rows.name: Recyda
rows.short: Providing SaaS for packaging data management to help businesses meet international recyclability requirements.
rows.description: Recyda provides SaaS for packaging data management to drive sustainability and accelerate the circular economy. This all-in-one solution helps companies digitally manage their full packaging portfolios by navigating the high complexity of country-specific regulations, waste infrastructure, and varying fee structures for recyclability, Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) fees, and plastic taxes. The software creates impact through core features that support the entire packaging lifecycle. It offers forecasting and modeling capabilities to accurately calculate fees and assess new packaging designs against international guidelines, directly supporting R&D and optimization. Additionally, built-in reporting and analytics ensure companies can easily meet internal and external requirements and make informed decisions about their entire portfolio.

rows.name: Refurbed
rows.short: Online marketplace for buying and selling professionally refurbished electronics.
rows.description: Refurbed's mission is to make sustainable technology accessible to everyone by offering high-quality, pre-owned devices at affordable prices. Their platform provides a wide selection of refurbished smartphones, laptops, tablets, and other electronics, all thoroughly inspected and restored to full working condition. By extending the lifespan of these products, Refurbed reduces electronic waste and promotes a circular economy, benefiting both consumers and the environment.

rows.name: Remberg
rows.short: Digitizing service processes of industrial machinery.
rows.description: Remberg's Asset-Relationship-Management (ARM) System is a cloud-based software solution that enables seamless service processes across organizations around your assets in one single platform. Manufacturers, service providers and operators of industrial assets access and process machine-related information such as documentation, spare parts, or service cases from one single source.

rows.name: Resourcify
rows.short: Helping companies to control and improve recycling through waste management optimization.
rows.description: Resourcify connects waste-producers and recyclers to make recycling easy, fast and affordable. With automated, digital workflows that make recycling more efficient and transparent, companies can recycle more and reduce costs, and turn waste into valuable materials. Together, with more than 220 waste management companies that use the platform, Resourcify has developed powerful software that simplifies recycling and helps companies save up to 30% of the costs compared to conventional waste management. In addition, Resoucify serves as the central tool to manage all your waste service providers globally.

rows.name: Revyze
rows.short: A social learning app designed for GenZ and GenAlpha.
rows.description: Founded in Paris in 2022 by Guillaume Perrot, Anatole Blanc, and Florent Sciberras, Revyze allows students to learn through short videos and quizzes created by their peers – combining the engaging elements of TikTok with the gamified structure of Duolingo. With over 1 million users and a growing community of verified creators, Revyze aims to reshape the learning experience. By making learning accessible, personalized, and social, Revyze is on a mission to democratize access to high-quality education globally.

rows.name: Rho Protocol
rows.short: On-chain, non-custodial interest rate futures and swaps market.
rows.description: Rho Labs, built Rho Protocol, an on-chain, non-custodial interest rate futures and swaps market and launched it in November 2023. The venue, custom-built for rates derivatives, seeks to combine transparency and efficiency of zero-counterparty risk on-chain trading, where collateral and risk are managed entirely on the blockchain, with the familiar experience and accessibility of centralized exchanges. Interest Rate Derivatives represent the largest asset class in traditional finance with over $500T in outstanding interest. Rho’s ultimate goal is to introduce this market to the advantages of on-chain trading while offering crypto traders the opportunity to trade the most prominent rates in the ecosystem, as enjoyed by participants of TradFi markets.

rows.name: Rive
rows.short: AI-powered residential real estate data platform.
rows.description: Rive is a PropTech startup and the leading iBuyer in Europe providing instant offers for apartment owners. They have developed a highly accurate AI-powered real estate data platform and revolutionary service concept redefining how people sell and buy homes, using technology to quickly purchase homes from sellers who desire convenience and speed.

rows.name: Rivia
rows.short: AI-driven analytics and data infrastructure for successful Biopharma clinical trials.
rows.description: Rivia addresses inefficiencies in biopharma clinical trials, where fragmented data and outdated tools hinder the development of new therapies. Their technology offers a real-time, integrated view of data to improve the evaluation of new treatments and trial conduct. Their vision is to become the unified data infrastructure that transforms clinical development lifecycles, bringing new therapies to market more successfully.

rows.name: roclub
rows.short: Solving the challenges of global staff shortage in healthcare with a teleoperation platform.
rows.description: roclub offers a teleoperation platform for medical technology to bridge the shortage of medical technical professionals and secure business continuity at any time, at any location and for any examination. The platform enables the remote access and operation of medical technology like MRI and CT scanners, facilitating use cases like remote scanning, remote (application)support, and remote education.

rows.name: Rollee
rows.short: Helping financial institutions to make fairer decisions by using the power of employment data.
rows.description: Rollee is a platform for employment data used by clients across various industries, from fleet management to lending, who are committed to making the fairest decisions with a data-driven approach. They can access through their customers' permission their income, activity, and other employment data points that will help to make more inclusive decisions.

rows.name: Runware
rows.short: Powering faster, lower-cost AI inference through one unified API.
rows.description: Runware is an AI inference platform that unifies access to hundreds of AI models through a single API. By combining custom inference hardware with an optimized software stack, it delivers materially faster performance and up to 10x lower costs than traditional cloud deployments. Developers can easily switch, route, or A/B test models at scale without vendor lock-in. Runware powers billions of AI generations for consumer and enterprise products worldwide.

rows.name: Saúde Bliss
rows.short: AI platform that simplifies and automates insurance for SMEs.
rows.description: Founded in Brazil, Saúde Bliss is an AI-powered insurance platform that streamlines how small and medium-sized businesses access, compare, and secure coverage. The platform automates the entire insurance workflow – from matching SMEs with the right products to generating instant quotes and issuing policies – removing the friction of traditional, manual processes. By integrating data-driven recommendations and seamless digital onboarding, Saúde Bliss helps insurers reach underserved segments while enabling SMEs to obtain affordable, transparent coverage in minutes.

rows.name: Scalarr
rows.short: Machine learning-based anti-fraud solution for mobile companies.
rows.description: When it comes to the biggest mobile advertising landscape threat, Scalarr uses 2 layers of the next‑generation Machine Learning algorithms that detects all types of mobile app-install fraud with dramatically improved accuracy up to 97%.

rows.name: Scalera
rows.short: Automating construction tendering and procurement with AI.
rows.description: Spun out of ETH Zürich, Scalera is an AI-powered SaaS platform designed to transform the complex world of construction procurement. The technology automatically parses massive tender documents, aligns technical requirements with local industry standards, and streamlines supplier coordination, compressing labor-intensive bidding cycles from several days into just a few hours. By embedding artificial intelligence deep into the construction supply chain, Scalera is establishing itself as the digital procurement backbone for leading construction firms across Europe. Scalera’s mission is to provide the essential infrastructure layer that enables the physical world to be built faster, more transparently, and with greater efficiency.

rows.name: Schüttflix
rows.short: Digital marketplace for bulk construction supplies.
rows.description: Schüttflix is the first digital marketplace and delivery platform for bulk construction supplies such as sand, crushed rock, and gravel. The Schüttflix app, which connects suppliers and truckers directly with customers in landscaping and the heavy construction industry, currently offers same day service and 4-hour delivery to its core market. As the supply market is extremely fragmented and non-transparent, Schüttflix is the first to provide easy online access to customers across Germany in one platform.

rows.name: Seafair
rows.short: Helping shipping companies manage data and recruit seafarers.
rows.description: Empowering crews and crew departments to be more effective, using data, technology and on the ground operations across across the world.

rows.name: Second Nature
rows.short: Inspiring and supporting people to live free of any lifestyle disease.
rows.description: Second Nature is a digital health program, proven to help people change their behaviors and reduce their risk to type 2 diabetes. It solves this issue by introducing a 6-week behavioral change program delivered digitally and supported by mentors and health tracking. Users receive a Second Nature smart scale and an activity tracker to track their health and outcomes. Additionally, they will be matched with a full-time coach, who will guide them through the prevention program and they learn how to prevent diabetes through Second Nature’s online education courses.

rows.name: Seltz
rows.short: Providing AI agents with programmable access to the web.
rows.description: Seltz is building the web retrieval and knowledge layer for the agentic internet. Its full-stack infrastructure gives AI systems fast, fresh and citable access to web information through an API, replacing search infrastructure built for humans with retrieval infrastructure built for machines.

rows.name: Sense Street
rows.short: Creating statistical language systems that are conditioned on conversations taking place in the Capital Markets.
rows.description: Thanks to our heavily curated datasets, we deploy deep learning methods to train models of natural language as it manifests on trading desks. This has resulted in production grade software that can extract both explicit and latent counter-party trading intentions with unprecedented accuracy. Our software turns trading desk into data driven functions, unlocking next generation CRM tools while automating human centric elements in the life cycle of a trade.

rows.name: Seqera Labs
rows.short: Simplifying complex data analysis pipelines in the cloud across pharma, genomics, and biotech.
rows.description: Seqera Labs is on a mission to simplify complex data analysis pipelines in the cloud, providing software that enables developers and data scientists to create and deploy data applications in any environment. Their core, open-source technology Nextflow transforms the building of massively scalable and distributed computing solutions, and empowers customers across pharma, genomics and biotech to break with the status quo of closed-platforms and custom scripts to embrace the Nextflow future of cloud.

rows.name: Shapr3D
rows.short: Quick iterative CAD for faster and better design decisions.
rows.description: Shapr3D builds instinctive CAD tools, helping design and manufacturing teams complete complex tasks with speed and efficiency. Through their multi-platform structure, you can work flexibly across devices. A non-hierarchical toolset makes Shapr3D quickly accessible, so every team member can contribute to the workflow, boosting overall output. Download Shapr3D from the App Store, Microsoft Store, or our website.

rows.name: Shpock
rows.short: One of Europe’s most popular shopping apps.
rows.description: Shpock (acquired in 2014) is a mobile marketplace that brings millions of private buyers and sellers together in categories that range from electronics and fashion to cars and property.

rows.name: SILQ
rows.short: Helping SMEs in emerging markets buy inventory, ship it, and get financing, all in one app.
rows.description: Formed by the merger of leading regional platforms Sary and ShopUp, SILQ Group provides a fully integrated ecosystem, combining B2B e-commerce, end-to-end logistics, and embedded financial services through its SILQFi arm. This full-stack approach allows the company to manage trade, facilitate cross-border shipments, and process payments seamlessly, supporting over 600,000 businesses across its network. The company's core mission is to solve the critical barriers facing small retailers and merchants in emerging economies: highly fragmented supply chains and limited access to formal banking or working capital. By integrating financial products—such as financing and cash management—directly into the commerce and logistics flow, SILQ enables these businesses to overcome capital constraints, scale smarter, and transition from traditional trading to modern, digitized operations.

rows.name: Simbel
rows.short: Helping HR teams run L&D operations seamlessly.
rows.description: Simbel also integrates with SMBs’ existing HR stack and uses periodic performance reviews as a starting point for identifying individual learning and development needs. It makes learning and development simple to deliver, allowing SMBs to benefit from the most up-to-date training from the best providers, while helping HR teams streamline all their L&D ops and measure the impact of the training.

rows.name: Skyfri
rows.short: Making renewable energy intelligent.
rows.description: Skyfri provides owners of renewable energy plants with sophisticated software to increase revenues and reduce downtime in production. Its platform is built to automate operations, maintenance, and asset management.

rows.name: Smiler
rows.short: The world’s first on-the-spot photography marketplace.
rows.description: Smiler believes that valuable memories deserve to be captured in high quality. It’s our mission to achieve that on a global scale for everyone, everywhere. We are the world’s first on-the-spot photography marketplace that brings photographers and consumers together at tourist hotspots and other leisure locations. By being in the places where these memories are created, Smiler taps into the uncaptured potential of billions of photos, preserving something higher quality and very valuable to people all around the world.

rows.name: SOC.OS
rows.short: Fundamentally re-imagining how security operations are conducted today.
rows.description: SOC.OS (acquired by Sophos in 2022) was born within the internal incubator of BAE Systems Applied Intelligence in late 2018 and spun-out as an independent company in June 2020. It is a SaaS product and can be thought of as an embedding an extra security analyst to the team, one who has the ability to remember every interconnected relationship between every alert produced from each security tool.

rows.name: Solvo.ai
rows.short: Optimizing supply chain networks and driving higher yields in logistics through human-machine collaboration.
rows.description: Solvo.ai is on a mission to build a ”central cross-functional brain” suite of products that combine human expertise with practical AI to make supply chains of the future resilient, agile and self learning by design. Our first MVP has been tested on real data from one of the leading global logistics service providers, with a target of 1000+ pricing experts. Our story is all about real people, real problems, real solutions, and real value.

rows.name: Sona
rows.short: Workforce management built for frontline workers.
rows.description: Sona’s mission is to put technology in the hands of frontline staff that transforms how they manage their work and engage with their employer. Designed for the specific needs of modern frontline workplaces, Sona’s employee app combines powerful productivity tools with a sleek, simple and intuitive user experience. Features include live schedule view, absence management, instant messaging, and Open Shifts, an innovative shift booking platform matching shift vacancies with employees willing to take on more hours. Trailblazing organisations across health and social care, retail, and the third sector are revolutionising the way they manage, engage and retain their staff.

rows.name: Sota
rows.short: Visual intelligence for enterprise.
rows.description: Every enterprise wants to run on AI, but today's tools and agents are built for individual tasks, not the complex production cycles and scale that companies require. Sota is building the operating system that facilitates AI-native content production end-to-end to make content an engine of growth rather than a cost.

rows.name: SpAItial
rows.short: Pioneering AI that understands and generates 3D worlds.
rows.description: SpAItial is pioneering Spatial Foundation Models (SFMs), a new AI paradigm that generates and reasons about the physics and appearance of real and imagined 3D environments. Unlike current 2D-based AI, SFMs operate natively in 3D space, enabling more human-like understanding. This technology can revolutionize industries by creating realistic virtual worlds (gaming, VR/AR), improving design (CAD), and enabling smarter robots. SpAItial's work bridges the gap between virtual and physical, creating AI that truly understands our 3D world.

rows.name: Stateless
rows.short: Making complex network functions easy to manage, fast, and scalable.
rows.description: Stateless was founded in 2016 with a vision to fundamentally re-think the architecture of network devices to meet today’s “as a service” demands. The company has developed first of its kind technology to allow network functions like firewalls and load balancers to be easily offered and consumed through the “as a service” model. Stateless' platform and network functions move networking infrastructures of all kinds into the cloud era, giving operators the flexibility and functionality today’s users badly need.

rows.name: Storyclash
rows.short: Optimizing marketing campaigns by monitoring the impact of content on social media in real time.
rows.description: Storyclash is a social media monitoring tool for publishers, giving them a real-time view of what kind of content is trending on the Internet by analyzing social media interactions like shares, comments, likes and other reactions. Publishers, brands and agencies are able to discover viral articles, watch competitors in real-time, and make data-driven decisions with Storyclash to get more website traffic, higher engagement, and optimize their marketing campaigns.

rows.name: Stotles
rows.short: Stotles helps businesses access the public sector market with a sales-enabling platform that surfaces opportunities before they come to market.
rows.description: Stotles was founded in 2019 with a mission to unlock the potential of business and government working better together, helping businesses get ahead in the £9 trillion (€10 trillion) global public sector market with its sales-enabling platform. Their platform organizes a massive amount of messy government data, surfaces tailored insights and gives teams workflow tools to find and shape opportunities earlier in the government buying cycle.

rows.name: Sunlight
rows.short: Helping companies create a highly engaging learning culture.
rows.description: Sunlight helps companies grow an engaging learning culture by facilitating their team’s access to any book, event, or course in the world, allowing businesses to allocate each team member with a learning and development budget and improving learning engagement by 34%. Through Sunlight employers can approve requests from their employees on everything from books to courses and events, and only get charged for what they use, in one monthly invoice.

rows.name: Surfboard
rows.short: A simpler, smarter and fairer collaborative team planning tool for customer support teams.
rows.description: Surfboard (exited in 2024) is a collaborative planning tool for customer support teams. It's shift planning, scheduling, and forecasting functionality allows support teams to make work more human by reducing burnout and increasing scheduling flexibility through a single source of truth connecting disparate systems in one place.

rows.name: SwipeGuide
rows.short: Standard-work procedure and knowledge management.
rows.description: SwipeGuide ( acquired by L2L in 2024 ) is the next-generation instruction software. It provides an intuitive way to create enhanced-reality work instructions in a matter of minutes. Machine operators and field service engineers visualize, standardize, and execute digital instructions on mobile devices.

rows.name: Sylvera
rows.short: Scaling negative emissions by driving better standards in the carbon markets.
rows.description: Sylvera combines state-of-the-art machine learning with geospatial data to transformationally improve the accuracy, regularity and cost of carbon offset monitoring.

rows.name: TalkJS
rows.short: Providing User-to-User Messaging as a Service.
rows.description: It takes an enormous effort to get custom messaging on a platform right. TalkJS solves this issue by introducing its one-line integration messaging service for any platform with peer-to-peer communication needs.

rows.name: Taxfix
rows.short: The intelligent platform for seamless personal tax filing.
rows.description: Speedinvest became a shareholder in Taxfix following its acquisition of TaxScouts in 2024.
