Taxfix is a digital tax platform focused on simplifying personal income tax filing through intuitive, mobile-first technology. By combining automation, AI-driven guidance, and access to certified tax advisors, Taxfix helps individuals file accurately, maximize refunds, and reduce the complexity traditionally associated with tax compliance. Operating across multiple European markets, Taxfix is redefining how people interact with their taxes. Through its acquisition of TaxScouts, Taxfix expanded its European footprint, including entry into the UK market, while strengthening its advisor-led tax filing capabilities for individuals, freelancers, and self-employed taxpayers.

rows.name: TaxScouts
rows.short: Personal income tax autopilot enabling simplicity, automation, and speed.
rows.description: TaxScouts (aquired by Taxfix in 2024) simplifies tax assessment and filing. The company has built the automation required to calculate, assess and reliably file personal income tax for non-standard incomes including professional freelancers, landlords, high earners and more.

rows.name: Telleroo
rows.short: An API for outgoing payments.
rows.description: Marketplaces need a scalable banking solution for conducting a high amount of outgoing payments. With Telleroo, businesses can send instant bank transfers directly from their back-end through a fully compliant payment API.

rows.name: tenyks
rows.short: Helping AI developers who work with computer vision data to build more reliable software faster.
rows.description: Tenyks is a University of Cambridge spin-out, inventing the way humanity interacts with AI to protect and delight. We are building an MLOps monitoring and validation platform that helps AI developers working with computer vision data to build more reliable software faster. Specifically, our platform helps ML developers understand what’s wrong with their software and fix it.

rows.name: text.cortex
rows.short: Combining advanced NLG algorithms with proven marketing practices to create the best AI software for copywriting.
rows.description: Berlin-based TextCortex is devoted to helping businesses become more open, public and searchable by enabling the creation of AI-developed text for their products, advertisements, blogs and other forms of the written word. The result? Lower costs and reduced human scalability limitations associated with writing text that a machine can understand.

rows.name: The Lowdown
rows.short: The UK’s leading reproductive and sexual health platform.
rows.description: The Lowdown (acquired by Vira Health in 2025) is a community based women's health review, advice and prescriptions platform. Starting with contraception, they are on a mission to put women in control of their reproductive health decisions through their unique dataset, digital tools and services.

rows.name: ThinkSono
rows.short: Advanced ultrasound diagnosis in the palm of your hand.
rows.description: ThinkSono has created the world’s first software to diagnose ‘deep vein thrombosis’ (DVT) at the point of care. DVT is caused by a blood clot in the leg and is responsible for 800,000 deaths in Europe and the USA. ThinkSono’s solution can diagnose DVT within one step at 30 times cheaper and 10 times faster than current solutions on the market.

rows.name: Tibo Energy
rows.short: Unlocking the power of smart grids with Energy Hub Software.
rows.description: tibo energy supports commercial and industrial customers in their energy transition journey by providing SaaS solutions for simulating and controlling energy hubs and smart grids. Their technology enables businesses to effectively manage and coordinate energy consumption, generation, and storage, leading to substantial cost savings and reductions in emissions.

rows.name: Tide
rows.short: SME challenger bank redefining business banking.
rows.description: Tide is a leading UK-based fintech platform built specifically to simplify banking and financial administration for Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs), freelancers, and sole traders. Operating entirely digitally, Tide provides its members with a dedicated business current account that is managed entirely through its proprietary mobile and web application. Beyond just standard transactions, Tide integrates core administrative features like invoicing, expense management, and receipt capture directly into the banking experience, turning the account into a comprehensive financial management hub for business owners.

rows.name: TIER
rows.short: Changing urban mobility for good.
rows.description: TIER (merged with Dott in January 2024) provides electric scooters that can be rented on demand to travel the last mile in cities to fight polluted cities, smog and ineffective, inconvenient, and overpriced transportation modes.

rows.name: Timberhub
rows.short: Digitally connecting manufacturers and contractors with sawmills across Europe.
rows.description: Despite its size, the timber industry still largely relies on slow, offline, and manual ways of doing business, leaving it vulnerable to supply shocks that make it difficult for manufacturers, wholesalers, and construction companies to source right-quality timber at sufficient quantities and reasonable prices. To counter this, Timberhub is digitizing the entire sawn timber procurement process with an end to end online marketplace for timber to support manufacturers and contractors in purchasing, transporting, and financing their raw materials. This marketplace also helps buyers to verify the origin of the timber traded on the platform, allowing them to make more ethical and sustainable purchases.

rows.name: Timeular
rows.short: Timeular helps knowledge workers to track, understand and improve how they spend their time at work.
rows.description: Timeular empowers people to improve their time management to create more value for themselves and the people around them. Their patented 8-sided device enables knowledge workers to accurately measure time spent on different tasks with a simple flip. The complimentary Timeular software and mobile app aggregates all data and gives users insights into how they spend their time and suggests actionable advice how to boost productivity. The device blew past its €75,000 goal on Kickstarter, going on to raise €313,637 from over 3,000 backers. After beating Kickstarter the company rapidly grew to more than 30,000 units sold and raised funds from Speedinvest and Ruvento.

rows.name: Toqio
rows.short: Helping companies create and launch their own fully branded banking or finance solutions.
rows.description: The Toqio platform empowers companies to quickly create and launch their own fully branded digital banking and finance solutions. This proprietary infrastructure provides the foundation clients need to rapidly bring new financial products to market without extensive development time. The solution is designed for maximum flexibility and rapid deployment, featuring both a Development Hub for incorporating other financial service providers and building unique, custom features, and the Toqio Marketplace. The Marketplace allows clients to instantly integrate pre-curated fintech modules from leading providers, with the added opportunity to share and monetize the modules they create themselves.

rows.name: TourRadar
rows.short: Online marketplace for multi-day tours and adventures.
rows.description: TourRadar is the leading online marketplace for multi-day tours and organized adventures. The platform makes it easy for travelers to find, compare, and book thousands of vetted small-group trips and longer organized journeys worldwide. The company's unique value is aggregating over 50,000 tours from more than 2,500 global operators, including major brands and independent local providers. This consolidation centralizes a traditionally fragmented market, offering travelers choice and price comparison for complex booking needs.

rows.name: Tower
rows.short: AI-native data infrastructure for reliable production deployment.
rows.description: Tower, a Berlin-based data infrastructure company acquired by MotherDuck in 2026, builds the ‘last mile’ platform for data engineers in the AI era. It enables teams to turn AI-generated and human-curated data pipelines into reliable, production-ready systems, unifying Python compute with storage based on open, Iceberg-based standards that keeps AI grounded in fresh, company-specific data.

rows.name: Tranched
rows.short: Automating complex securitisation transactions, reducing friction and costs.
rows.description: Tranched, is the first Deep Tokenisation embedded securitisation platform directly connecting lenders to investors, allowing them to structure and manage a transaction in a fraction of the time and cost. Our platform provides better, quicker, and more efficient access to financing for lenders, and broader investment opportunities to investors.

rows.name: trawa
rows.short: Professionalizing and simplifying the procurement of electricity for energy-intensive companies.
rows.description: With trawa, companies gain access to customized energy procurement that combines all available products, including power purchase agreements with solar and wind farms. This secures long-term energy procurement and promotes the expansion of renewable energy without government subsidies.To analyze load profiles, identify savings potential and create an optimized energy portfolio, trawa relies on an AI-based software solution. This can unlock potential in electricity procurement and deliver savings of up to 20 percent.

rows.name: tulipshare
rows.short: An activist platform empowering retail investors to promote ethical change.
rows.description: Today, most retail investors take a passive approach to investing by investing in ETFs or working directly with an advisor. As a result, they may lose out on their chance to align their investment strategy with their views. We started Tulipshare with a simple idea: Empower retail investors to invest their money so as to promote ethical change. Through our platform, we enable retail investors to invest in activist campaigns to change publicly traded companies from the inside. We then unify their investing power with other like-minded investors and seek to make their voice heard by big business.

rows.name: Tulyp
rows.short: Digitizes and secures the entire trade finance process, making global markets more accessible to SMEs.
rows.description: Tulyp enhances the value for small and medium-sized businesses by enabling faster, more secure international deal closings beyond traditional processes, mitigating risks in import-export transactions – such as counterparty and document fraud risks – and ensuring secure and transparent payment terms that protect both buyers and sellers. Tulyp also collaborates with global financing companies to alleviate cash flow problems, reducing financial risks and accelerating import-export transactions by providing a one-stop shop that consolidates all necessary services, streamlining the entire process for SMEs engaged in international trade.

rows.name: TurinTech
rows.short: Automating the entire process of creating, deploying, and optimizing AI.
rows.description: Turin Tech is enabling businesses to automatically build, optimize with multiple objectives and deploy models within days via their platform EvoML - the only platform that can optimize models at high speed and low latency, as well as embed code optimization for optimal performance without compromising accuracy or other business metrics.

rows.name: Tuum
rows.short: Core Banking. Without Limits.
rows.description: Tuum's mission is to set banks free by enabling them to quickly and safely replace their legacy systems, reducing their maintenance costs, and unlocking new opportunities to adapt and prosper in the digital age. By employing a smart migration approach, Tuum aids banks in moving off their current systems, with clients typically going live within just seven months. Once operational, Tuum's system empowers banks to effortlessly launch new products and enter new market verticals. Providing more than just core functionality, Tuum allows banks to operate multiple business lines from a single system, including accounts, lending, payments, and cards. Beyond this, banks can expand their capabilities through access to a pre-configured ecosystem of partner solutions. Tuum also facilitates business transformation. Its Business Builder enables banks to precisely configure their operating, sourcing, and distribution models, launching unique models that capitalize on the digital revolution.

rows.name: TWAICE
rows.short: Using digital twins for more sustainable and reliable mobility.
rows.description: TWAICE delivers solutions based on digital twins to fleet operators, battery and electric vehicle manufacturers to reduce battery development and testing costs as well as to increase battery reliability and lifetime. Their solutions are built around the belief that it should be simple to test and operate complex technical systems like batteries while always having the appropriate knowledge available.

rows.name: Ultimate
rows.short: Bringing Decentralized Finance to everyday investors around the world.
rows.description: Ultimate empowers everyone to access the world of Decentralized Finance by providing a user-friendly “front door” to crypto trading, high-yield DeFi investing opportunities, NFT art & collectibles and other Web3 services, all bundled into an intuitive mobile application. The Ultimate product is a consumer-grade, non-custodial crypto wallet allowing people to easily track, discover, invest in, and store a wide variety of on-chain assets. Our thesis is that the super apps of tomorrow will be non-custodial DeFi wallets that have the potential to contain your entire digital identity.

rows.name: Unweave
rows.short: Giving developers instant access to serverless infrastructure for machine learning.
rows.description: Unweave gives developers instant access to the infrastructure they need to train their machine learning models with almost zero setup. It lets users run their machine learning code on GPUs with a single command without having to setup any custom cloud infrastructure. Our goal is to wrap the power of the cloud within the UX of your laptop. We want to turn every developer’s laptop into a supercomputer.

rows.name: Upvest
rows.short: Investment infrastructure powering modern financial products.
rows.description: Upvest enables businesses to build great investment experiences, tailored to their customers’ needs. Their single investment API and digital infrastructure – along with the modular design – make it easy and cost-effective to offer customized investment products. It’s all backed by comprehensive support, covering everything from licenses and vendor management to back and middle office.

rows.name: Usersnap
rows.short: Visual bug tracking and feedback tool.
rows.description: Usersnap (acquired by saas.group in 2023) is a visual bug tracking and feedback tool. The software lets users screenshot and annotate their current browser view facilitating communication and the flow of feedback between developers, customers and everyone involved in a web project. Usersnap integrates with existing project management tools, bug tracking systems as well as popular web platforms such as Wordpress. Among their customers are large technology companies including Google, Facebook, Microsoft and Netflix.

rows.name: Vocca AI
rows.short: Automating patient calls for healthcare providers with AI-powered assistants.
rows.description: Vocca’s AI receptionist answers, books, and handles patient calls 24/7, eliminating hold times and freeing up staff for in-person care. The platform automates appointment scheduling, reminders, and patient queries, resolving over 80% of requests—directly in medical software or CRM. With the ability to manage 100+ simultaneous calls, securely log every conversation, and engage patients seamlessly across phone, SMS, and WhatsApp, Vocca addresses high call volumes, appointment no-shows, and staff overload. The result is faster service, happier patients, and clinics that run more efficiently and cost-effectively.

rows.name: Wasmer
rows.short: Making WebAssembly accessible to developers and enterprises.
rows.description: With Wasmer, enterprises can run ultra-lightweight containerized software with blazing-fast startup times, at near-native speeds anywhere — be it on servers, edge, and IoT devices or in serverless environments. It brings a vastly improved and simpler to use API, massive performance improvements, support for Apple Silicon, a pluggable infrastructure for easy customization, and support for “Headless Wasmer” a new ultra-lightweight runtime that is ideal for IoT.

rows.name: Wayflyer
rows.short: Revenue-based financing for e-commerce brands.
rows.description: The dedicated growth engine for ambitious e-commerce and Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) brands globally. Wayflyer pioneered revenue-based financing (RBF), a fast, flexible alternative to traditional loans or equity sales. Fund and optimzing growth, the platform provides proprietary analytics and benchmarking tools that give brands critical insights into cash flow and ad spend performance, ensuring every dollar is invested where it will generate the maximum return, turning working capital into a true competitive advantage.

rows.name: wefox
rows.short: Making insurance simpler.
rows.description: wefox connects customers with various insurance companies and licensed brokers, using technology to streamline everything from policy shopping to claims processing for products like car, health, and household coverage By blending digital tools with real, human advice from digitally-supported brokers, wefox is making insurance approachable and accessible for all.

rows.name: Wikidocs
rows.short: Turning web pages into live, editable “docs” services in minutes.
rows.description: Wikidocs (acquired by Atlassian) was a real-time collaboration framework that turns any web page into a live, editable ‘docs’ service in minutes with the ability to build content, create, edit, and share – all at once. The solution saved users the hours of wait and back and forth communication waiting to receive the latest version with changes. Wikidocs offered this service through an API and a few lines of Javascript to be added to client websites.

rows.name: Wikifolio
rows.short: Allowing day traders and asset managers to publish their portfolios for other traders to access and invest in.
rows.description: Wikifolio is an online platform that allows day traders to publish their portfolios for other traders to access and invest. Investment bankers and hobby-traders alike can use this app to connect and evolve. The “wikifolios” turn portfolios created on the platform into fully-fledged financial products which are then listed on the stock exchange Börse Stuttgart. Each trade, including execution price and fees, is updated in real-time on Wikifolio and partner sites to give the user clarity over the movements in the market. Some of Wikifolio’s certificates have been consecutively included in the top 10 most-traded products in their category of the Stuttgart Stock Exchange (EUWAX) in 2017.

rows.name: YardLink
rows.short: Construction equipment rental B2B marketplace.
rows.description: Plant and Tool Hire Made Easy. YardLink is taking the hassle out of hiring equipment. YardLink aggregates supply and optimizes distance to the closest rental. Guaranteed reliability of service and availability of the equipment.

rows.name: Yokoy
rows.short: The all-in-one spend management platform.
rows.description: Experiencing the pain of manually preparing, tracking, checking, approving and processing expenses first-hand, the five co-founders of Yokoy, Dr. Devis Lussi, Lars Mangelsdorf, Melanie Gabriel, Philippe Sahli and Thomas Inhelder, set out to start an expense revolution. Zurich-based Yokoy ( acquired by TravelPerk in 2025 ) automates spend management for medium and large enterprises with artificial intelligence, combining expense management, supplier invoice management and smart corporate cards into one single intuitive platform.

rows.name: 10 Percent
rows.short: Building the infrastructure that lets FMCG brands own loyalty, data, and customer relationships, not the retailers.
rows.description: The app gives consumers 10% cashback on their favorite brands, no matter where they shop. Behind the scenes, 10% powers a data-rich, brand-centric loyalty engine that helps FMCGs activate their audiences, predict churn and trends, innovate with real insights, and retake control. Brands even secure exclusive access to their category, locking out competitors for months. 10% is creating the default operating system for brand loyalty and consumer data.

rows.name: 9am.health
rows.short: Care that connects it all.
rows.description: 9amHealth offers complete cardiometabolic care—a first-of-its-kind, whole-body approach to preventing and treating diabetes, obesity, high cholesterol, and hypertension. 9amHealth partners with employers, PBMs and healthplans to provide effective health benefits for those living with chronic conditions. Their members receive personalized care plans, prescription delivery, at-home lab tests, and unlimited specialist access.

rows.name: + Simple
rows.short: Digital insurance provider for SME’s.
rows.description: +Simple is the leading digital insurance provider for SME’s in France. By integrating with the +Simple platform, either as a white-label or native solution, brokers and agents in the commercial insurance space are able to quickly and efficiently quote, bind and issue policies to their business clients. Using +Simple’s technology and carrier network, intermediaries are able to easily build modular products tailored to merchants’ highly specialized coverage needs. Through their online portal digitally native businesses are able to get a comprehensive and bespoke policy in a matter of minutes. By working directly with insurance carriers, brokers / agents, and SME’s alike +Simple is involved with all major players in the value chain streamlining the entire commercial insurance process throughout.
